content.title: Reading: Incomplete Sentences
content.scenario_summary: Thirty independent workplace situations: portal reservations at a coworking space; conditional acceptance of rush printing; protection of translated trade secrets; delivery of photography originals; advance rail reservations; family insurance enrollment; roof inspection; completed warehouse loading; root-growth allowances in landscape plans; bicycle repair estimates; systematic architectural filing; airport shuttle boarding; recruitment placement comparisons; reopening a library reading room; community weed removal; conference slide approval; delayed catering delivery; museum packing; seal inspection; amplifier warranties; harbor passenger lists; mentor enrollment; produce origin labels; provisional packaging approval; storage subscription restrictions; spacious gym lockers; supervisor-approved training; rental form submission; hypothetical book delivery; and individual recycling-bin processing.

questions.prompt: Members of the coworking space can avoid {{q1}} the reception desk by reserving meeting rooms through the online portal.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 calling，因為 avoid 在此以動名詞片語表示要避免的行為。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句意是會員透過線上入口預約會議室，就可以省去打電話給櫃檯的步驟。avoid 的受詞是「打電話給櫃檯」這件事，因此使用 calling the reception desk。can 後面接的原形動詞是 avoid；後面的 calling 則由 avoid 的補語結構決定。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: call 是原形動詞；can 已經支配 avoid，不能因此把 avoid 後面表示另一項行為的動詞也直接寫成 call。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: to call 是不定詞；在本句「避免做某事」的結構中，avoid 後面接動名詞，而非 to 不定詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: calling 是動名詞，帶著受詞 the reception desk，一起作為 avoid 的受詞，表示省去打電話這項行為。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: called 是過去式或過去分詞；這個形式無法在 avoid 後面構成本句所需的行為受詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷第二個動詞的形式時，要看前一個動詞的補語搭配；avoid doing 表示避免做某事。

questions.prompt: The print shop accepted the rush order {{q2}} condition that the customer approve the proof before noon and waive further design changes.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 on；on condition that 表示「以……為條件」。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 印刷店願意接急件，但要求顧客中午前核准打樣，並放棄後續設計變更。on condition that 後接完整子句，將接受訂單與這兩項條件連結起來。that 子句中的 approve 與 waive 並列，呈現店家提出的要求。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: on 與 condition that 組成 on condition that，準確表達印刷店接受急件所附的條件。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: for 可引出目的或理由，但 for condition that 不是本句用來提出接單條件的結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: to 可標示方向、對象或其他關係，但 to condition that 無法表達這裡「以顧客完成某事為條件」的意思。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: in condition 可用於描述狀況，例如 in good condition；本句後接的是要求顧客行動的 that 子句，不是在描述物品狀態。

explanation.takeaway_zh: on condition that 加子句，可用來交代同意、核准或接受某事的前提條件。

questions.prompt: Because the report contains trade secrets, the translation service must keep its contents {{q3}} and share them only with staff authorized by the client.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 confidential，表示報告內容應予保密，僅限客戶授權的人員接觸。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前半句說報告包含商業機密，後半句又把分享對象限於客戶授權的員工。這兩個線索都指向資訊保密。keep its contents confidential 中，confidential 是受詞補語，說明 contents 必須維持的狀態。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: public 表示公開的；要求將商業機密維持公開，與本句嚴格限定分享對象的保密目的相反。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: unrestricted 表示不受限制的；報告內容只可提供給客戶授權人員，正存在明確的存取限制。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: openly accessible 表示可公開取得的；這會讓未獲授權的人也能取得內容，與 only 所設定的範圍不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: confidential 表示機密的、須保密的；keep information confidential 正符合保護商業機密並限制分享對象的要求。

explanation.takeaway_zh: keep 加受詞再加形容詞，可表達維持某種狀態；資訊保密常用 keep information confidential。

questions.prompt: The photographer submitted the image files on time; {{q4}}, she included a separate folder containing the original, unedited versions.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 moreover，以連接副詞補充攝影師另外提供的檔案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 分號前後各有完整子句：攝影師準時交件，另外也附上未編輯原檔的資料夾。moreover 表示「此外」，可在分號後、逗號前引出補充資訊。其他選項的連接功能或所需補語形式，都不符合本句現有的標點與句構。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whereas 可引出對比子句，但本句第二項是在補充交件內容，並非對比；而 whereas 後緊接這個逗號也不符合此處的子句連接方式。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: moreover 是連接副詞，可用「分號＋moreover＋逗號」補充另一項事實，符合本句兩項並列的交件資訊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: despite 是介系詞；後面不能直接接 she included 這個完整子句。若要接子句，需要改成 despite the fact that 等結構。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: because 引出原因子句，但此處逗號後的 she included 沒有搭配適當的主句結構；附原檔也不是句中交代的準時交件原因。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 辨認連接詞時，同時檢查語意關係、是否連接完整子句，以及分號和逗號的位置。

questions.prompt: Passengers must obtain seat reservations {{q5}} advance, even when their rail passes already cover the entire fare.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 in；in advance 表示事先、提前。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句意是鐵路通行證即使已涵蓋全部票價，旅客仍須事先辦理劃位。空格與 advance 構成修飾 obtain 的時間片語，所需搭配是 in advance。票價是否已付清，與劃位是否須提前辦理是兩項不同要求。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: at 可與特定時間搭配，例如 at noon，但 at advance 不是這裡表示提前辦理的片語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: in advance 是「事先」的常用搭配，說明旅客應在乘車前完成劃位。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: by 可標示期限，例如 by Friday；advance 在這裡不是一個可由 by 引出的截止時間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: on 可接日期或形成其他固定片語，但 on advance 不能在本句中表達「提前」。

explanation.takeaway_zh: in advance 指提前完成某事；不要把它與 by 加具體截止時間的用法混淆。

questions.prompt: Employees choosing family coverage may add a spouse to their health insurance {{q6}} during the annual enrollment period.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 plan，health insurance plan 是可將配偶納入保障的健康保險方案。
explanation.reasoning_zh: family coverage 表示家庭保障，annual enrollment period 則是每年可辦理加入或變更投保的期間。句中的 add a spouse to 指把配偶加入保障範圍，因此受詞應是保險方案 plan，而非說明文件、保費金額或付款收據。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: brochure 是簡介或宣傳手冊；把配偶加入手冊不等於將配偶納入家庭保險保障。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: premium 是保費，即投保所支付的金額；配偶可加入保險方案，但不是加入一筆保費。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: receipt 是收據，記錄已發生的付款；本句描述辦理家庭投保，並非在收據上加註人名。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: plan 是方案；health insurance plan 指健康保險方案，可以在投保期間加入配偶作為受保障對象。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分保險相關名詞：plan 是方案，premium 是保費，receipt 是付款收據。

questions.prompt: The building manager requested an {{q7}} of the roof after workers discovered water stains on the top-floor ceiling.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 inspection，作為 requested 的名詞受詞，表示要求檢查屋頂。
explanation.reasoning_zh: an 後面的空格與 of the roof 共同構成受詞名詞片語，說明管理員要求的是哪一項作業。inspection 是可數名詞，an inspection of the roof 表示一次屋頂檢查；其他詞形無法直接構成本句所需的名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: inspection 是名詞，an inspection of the roof 表示對屋頂進行一次檢查，符合水漬出現後的處置。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: inspect 是動詞原形；an inspect of the roof 無法構成此處所需的名詞受詞。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: inspected 是過去式或過去分詞；在本句中沒有名詞供其修飾，也不能直接放在 an 後作為檢查作業的名稱。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: inspectable 是形容詞，表示可供檢查的；本句需要的是檢查這項作業，而不是形容某個省略的物品。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找出空格所在的整個成分；an inspection of something 是「對某物的一次檢查」。

questions.prompt: Loading ended at 6:05, so by the time the dispatch supervisor arrived at 6:15, the crew {{q8}} all forty pallets.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 had loaded；裝貨在主管到場前已經結束，應用過去完成式。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 題目明說裝貨於 6:05 結束，而主管到場是 6:15。兩個過去時間點建立了先後順序：裝完四十個棧板在前，到場在後。had loaded 表達截至那個過去時間已完成的動作；不能把已於 6:05 結束的裝貨描述為 6:15 仍在進行。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: was loading 是過去進行式；若表示主管 6:15 到場時仍在裝貨，會與 Loading ended at 6:05 的明確資訊衝突。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: has loaded 是現在完成式，以現在為時間基準；本句要交代的是主管過去到場前已完成的工作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: had loaded 是過去完成式，準確標示裝貨已在主管 6:15 到場之前完成。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: will load 是未來式；本句已交代裝貨在過去的 6:05 結束，不是在說之後才要裝貨。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 過去完成式可標示早於另一個過去事件的已完成動作；先用題目明示的時間建立順序。

questions.prompt: Before finalizing the planting layout, the designer must {{q9}} allowance for the space each tree's roots will need as they grow.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 make；make allowance for 在此表示考量樹根生長所需的空間。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 景觀設計師在定案前，須把樹根未來生長所需的空間納入規劃。make allowance for 加名詞片語，可表示因某個因素而作出適當預留或調整。這裡的 allowance 不是領取的津貼，而是規劃中對生長空間的考量。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: draw 可用於繪製圖面，也可在其他情境表示領取款項；但 draw allowance for the space 不能表達本句所需的預留生長空間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: place 可表示放置或下訂單；place allowance for 不是本句「將某因素納入考量」所需的搭配。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: take 可與 account 組成 take account of，但本句已有 allowance for，不能把另一組片語的動詞直接套用過來。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: make 與 allowance for 搭配，表示規劃時考量或預留樹根將來需要的空間，與後面的成長資訊一致。

explanation.takeaway_zh: make allowance for 表示考量某因素並預作調整；注意它與 take account of 使用不同的動詞。

questions.prompt: Without inspecting the damaged bicycle, the mechanic can provide only a rough {{q10}} of the repair cost, rather than a firm quotation.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 estimate；尚未檢查自行車，只能先提供粗略的維修費估算。
explanation.reasoning_zh: without inspecting 說明技師尚未取得完整的損壞資訊，rather than a firm quotation 又排除了確定報價。a rough estimate of the repair cost 正好指大致估算維修費用。其餘選項屬於付款或退款文件與款項，並非對尚未確定的費用作出預估。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: estimate 是估算，rough estimate 可表示在正式檢查前先提供的大致費用，與 firm quotation 形成合理對照。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: receipt 是收據，記錄收到的款項；題目沒有說已付款，而是在詢問未確定的維修成本。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: installment 是分期付款中的一期款項；它不是對整體維修成本的粗略預估。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: refund 是退款，指退還先前收取的金額；此處尚在估價階段，並未描述退費。

explanation.takeaway_zh: rough estimate 是粗估；firm quotation 是確定報價。先判斷交易目前處於估價還是付款階段。

questions.prompt: The architectural studio organized the drawings {{q11}}, grouping them by floor and room number rather than by creation date.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 systematically；依樓層及房號分類，表示按明確系統整理建築圖面。
explanation.reasoning_zh: grouping them by floor and room number 明示整理依據是樓層與房號，rather than by creation date 又排除按製作時間排列。因此 systematically 能描述本句採用明確分類系統的整理方式。四個選項都是副詞，需比較它們所表達的實際整理方法。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: chronologically 表示按時間先後排列；本句明說依樓層和房號分類，而非按製作日期，因此不是採用這種整理依據。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: haphazardly 表示雜亂地、缺少規劃地；本句已交代按樓層與房號進行有規則的分類，與此整理方式不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: systematically 表示有系統地；樓層與房號提供明確的分類依據，符合本句所描述的整理方法。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: indiscriminately 表示不加區分地；本句明確區分圖面所屬的樓層與房間，因此不能用它描述這項分類作業。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷整理方式的副詞時，要找出分類依據；按樓層及房號可稱 systematically，按時間先後則是 chronologically。

questions.prompt: Passengers {{q12}} the airport shuttle are asked to keep the aisle clear while the driver checks tickets and helps travelers with luggage.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 boarding，以現在分詞片語修飾正在登上機場接駁車的乘客。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本句的主要謂語是 are asked。空格起至 the airport shuttle 的部分修飾 Passengers，指出哪一群乘客受到提醒。乘客主動登上接駁車，因此用 boarding，形成可對應到 who are boarding the airport shuttle 的修飾片語。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: board 是原形動詞；在本句已有主要謂語 are asked 的情況下，不能不加關係詞或連接詞就再接一個獨立的 board 謂語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: boarding 是現在分詞，保留 the airport shuttle 作受詞，整個片語主動修飾正在上車的乘客。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: boarded 若作過去式，會與後面的 are asked 形成未連接的謂語；若作被動修飾語，後面的 the airport shuttle 又無法充當這種被動片語的直接受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: boards 是第三人稱單數現在式，既不能與複數 Passengers 搭配，也無法在這個位置形成所需的分詞修飾語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 已有主要謂語時，先判斷另一個動詞是否屬於修飾名詞的分詞片語，並確認主動或被動關係。

questions.prompt: The recruitment firm placed twice {{q13}} engineers in permanent jobs this quarter as it did in the same period last year.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 as many；twice as many engineers ... as 表示工程師人數是去年同期的兩倍。
explanation.reasoning_zh: engineers 是複數可數名詞，後方 as it did 引出去年同期的比較基準。表示人數倍數時，可用「倍數＋as many＋複數名詞＋as」。did 代替前面 placed engineers in permanent jobs 的動作，避免重複整個謂語。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: as many 與 twice 及後面的 as 呼應，且 many 配合可數複數 engineers，完整表達兩倍人數。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: as much 適合比較不可數的量；engineers 指一位位工程師的人數，在這裡應用 many。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: more than 可出現在其他比較結構中，但 twice more than engineers ... as 無法與本句後面的 as 子句組成正確的人數倍數結構。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: so many 可表示如此多的人數，但 twice so many engineers ... as 不是本句所需的倍數比較形式。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 倍數比較要同時檢查前後框架與名詞：twice as many 加複數可數名詞，再以 as 引出基準。

questions.prompt: The public library will reopen its reading room {{q14}} the maintenance team has removed the scaffolding and completed a final safety check.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 once，連接維修團隊完成作業後閱覽室才會重新開放的時間關係。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後有主詞 the maintenance team，以及 has removed 和 completed 這兩個並列的動作，因此是一個完整子句。once 可引出時間副詞子句，表示一旦拆除鷹架並完成安全檢查，圖書館就會重新開放閱覽室。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: during 是介系詞，可接 during the maintenance work 等名詞片語；本句後面直接接完整的主詞與謂語，形式不符。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: despite 是介系詞，不能直接接本句的完整子句；它表達的讓步關係也不是此處完成作業後再開放的時間關係。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: throughout 是介系詞，可表示貫穿某段期間，但不能直接接 the maintenance team has removed 這種完整子句。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: once 可接完整子句，表示在所列作業完成後，閱覽室即可重新開放，句構與語意皆合適。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先分清空格後是名詞片語還是完整子句；once 可接子句，during 則通常接名詞片語。

questions.prompt: To prevent weeds from competing with vegetable seedlings, community garden members should {{q15}} the weeds by hand before their roots spread.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 remove；為避免雜草與菜苗爭奪資源，應趁根部擴散前拔除雜草。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句首的目的片語明確指出要防止雜草與蔬菜幼苗競爭，空格後的受詞又是 the weeds。四個選項雖然都可描述園藝活動，但只有 remove 能在根系擴散前把雜草移除，直接達成此處的目的。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: fertilize 是施肥；對雜草施肥會促進其生長，無法達成本句防止它們與菜苗競爭的目的。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: remove 是移除、清除；remove the weeds by hand 表示用手除草，符合在根部擴散前處理的要求。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: irrigate 是灌溉；為雜草供水並不會將它們從菜苗周圍清除，與所述目的不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: plant 是種植；本句要處理已經可能與菜苗競爭的雜草，而不是再種下雜草。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 字彙題先找行動目的，再確認動詞的實際受詞；本題被處理的是雜草，不是菜苗。

questions.prompt: All conference speakers must receive written {{q16}} from the planning committee before adding promotional material to their presentation slides.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 approval；receive written approval 表示取得書面核准。
explanation.reasoning_zh: receive 後需要受詞，written 在此修飾空格所填的名詞，from the planning committee 則指出核准的來源。approval 是名詞，可組成 written approval，表示講者在簡報加入宣傳資料之前，必須先取得籌備委員會的書面同意。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: approve 是動詞，表示核准；receive written approve 不能形成 receive 所需的名詞受詞。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: approved 是過去式或過去分詞；written approved 在這裡沒有形成一個可由 receive 接受的完整名詞片語。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: approval 是名詞，written approval 是書面核准，正好作為 receive 的受詞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: approvingly 是副詞，表示以贊同的態度；本句要說收到何種核准，而不是修飾收到的方式。

explanation.takeaway_zh: receive approval from someone 表示取得某人的核准；written approval 特別指書面核准。

questions.prompt: Because the restaurant's storage area is closed through Thursday, the caterer will {{q17}} Wednesday's tableware delivery until Friday.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 postpone；原訂週三的餐具配送要延到週五才能進行。
explanation.reasoning_zh: storage area is closed through Thursday 表示儲存區直到週四結束都不能使用。原訂週三送達，而新的時間是週五，因此配送時間向後移動，應用 postpone。postpone something until 加日期，可表示將原訂事項延後至該日。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: accelerate 是加速或使提早；由週三移至週五是延後，並非加快，而且本句 until Friday 的延期結構也不適合 accelerate。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: repeat 是重複；題目要調整原訂週三的這一次配送，並未安排在儲存區關閉期間反覆配送。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: divide 是分割；句中沒有把餐具配送拆成幾批的資訊，空格後的 until Friday 要表達的是改期。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: postpone 是延後；postpone Wednesday's delivery until Friday 正確連結原訂時間與新的配送日。

explanation.takeaway_zh: postpone an event until 加時間，表示把原訂事項延後；先比較原日期與新日期的先後。

questions.prompt: The fragile ceramic vessels must {{q18}} by trained art handlers before they are moved from storage to the museum's new exhibition gallery.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 be packed；陶器是被包裝的物品，must 後須使用被動形式。
explanation.reasoning_zh: by trained art handlers 明確指出執行包裝的人員，而主詞 The fragile ceramic vessels 是接受包裝的陶器。因此使用 must be packed，結構為情態助動詞 must 加 be 原形，再加過去分詞 packed。之後才將陶器從庫房移到展廳。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: packing 是現在分詞或動名詞；must 後不能直接以 packing 形成這裡所需的被動謂語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: be packed 是被動結構；配合 must，表示這些陶器必須由受訓的藝術品搬運人員包裝。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: pack 是主動原形；must pack 會把陶器寫成執行包裝的主體，與 by 後明示的人員分工不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: have packed 是主動完成形式；它沒有表達陶器接受包裝，也無法配合 by trained art handlers 作為本句的被動施事者片語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 依實際動作關係判斷語態；情態助動詞後的被動式是 must be 加過去分詞。

questions.prompt: Inspectors check each seal {{q19}} under a bright lamp, looking for tiny gaps that could allow moisture into the finished product.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 carefully，以副詞說明檢查人員檢視封口的方式。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 句子的主要結構是 Inspectors check each seal。空格補充 check 這個動作如何執行，而不是描述 seal 的狀態或另加一個名詞受詞。carefully 是副詞，表示仔細檢查，以找出可能讓水氣進入的微小縫隙。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: carefully 是副詞，可修飾 check，表示檢查人員仔細查看每個封口。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: careful 是形容詞；check each seal careful 在本句中不是表達檢查方式的正確結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: care 可作名詞或動詞，但在 check each seal 後直接放 care，無法形成此處修飾檢查方式的成分。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: carefulness 是名詞，指細心這項特質；本句已有 each seal 作為 check 的受詞，這個名詞不能直接充當方式副詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷空格是描述動作還是名詞；描述「如何檢查」可使用副詞 carefully。

questions.prompt: The audio equipment supplier offers a three-year {{q20}} under which it must pay all costs of repairing manufacturing defects in its amplifiers.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 warranty；供應商須在三年保固期間支付製造瑕疵的全部維修費用。
explanation.reasoning_zh: under which it must pay all costs 明確規定供應商負有支付全部維修費的義務，而非僅預測費用金額。three-year 說明這項承諾的期間，manufacturing defects 則界定維修責任的範圍，因此所提供的是三年保固 warranty。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: estimate 是估價或估算，可以預測三年內的維修費用；但估算本身不是本句明示的、要求供應商支付全部瑕疵維修費的保固承諾。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: deposit 是訂金或押金，指預先支付或作為擔保的一筆款項；本句描述的是供應商在三年內承擔維修費的義務，而不是交付或保管一筆款項。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: warranty 是保固；本句以 under which it must pay 說明供應商依這項三年保固負有支付製造瑕疵維修費的義務，語意完整吻合。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: receipt 是收據，用來記錄已收取的款項；本句沒有在描述收款憑證，而是在規定供應商未來三年內須履行的瑕疵維修承諾。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分 estimate 與 warranty 時，要看內容是在預測費用，還是明文承諾承擔產品的瑕疵維修責任。

questions.prompt: The list of passengers who have booked the harbor tour {{q21}} on the captain's tablet, so no paper copy is needed.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 appears；主要子句的主詞是單數 The list，而非較近的 passengers。
explanation.reasoning_zh: of passengers 說明名單的內容，who have booked the harbor tour 再修飾 passengers。主要子句真正與空格動詞對應的核心名詞仍是 list。單數第三人稱主詞在本句的一般現在式中搭配 appears，表示名單顯示在船長的平板上。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: appears 是第三人稱單數現在式，與主詞 The list 一致，符合顯示在平板上的敘述。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: appear 沒有第三人稱單數詞尾；此處主詞是單數 list，不能因中間出現 passengers 就使用 appear。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: have appeared 的助動詞 have 不與本句的第三人稱單數主詞 list 一致；若用現在完成式，助動詞形式須是 has。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: are appearing 的 are 不與第三人稱單數主詞 list 一致；中間的 passengers 並不是這個主要謂語的主詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主詞與動詞之間即使隔著介系詞片語和關係子句，主要動詞仍須與核心主詞一致。

questions.prompt: Members seeking a mentor must {{q22}} the association's mentoring program through the registration page before the matching process begins next month.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 sign up for；想獲配導師的會員，須先透過登記頁面報名。
explanation.reasoning_zh: seeking a mentor 指出會員想加入配對，registration page 則指出辦理報名的管道，並須在下個月配對開始前完成。sign up for a program 表示報名參加計畫，能同時符合參與目的、辦理方式及截止時點。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: drop out of 是退出；想獲得導師配對的會員需要加入計畫，而不是在配對前退出。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: turn down 是拒絕；拒絕這項計畫不符合句首 seeking a mentor 所表達的參與目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: sign up for 是報名參加；透過 registration page 加入導師計畫，才能進入之後的配對程序。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: put off 是延後；本句要求在既定配對開始前完成登記，並非要求會員延後整項計畫。

explanation.takeaway_zh: sign up for 加課程、活動或計畫，表示報名參加；可由 registration、enrollment 等線索辨識。

questions.prompt: To avoid misleading customers, vendors at the farmers market must {{q23}} display the country of origin on all imported produce.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 clearly，以副詞修飾 display，表示清楚標示產地。
explanation.reasoning_zh: must 後的主要動詞是 display，受詞為 the country of origin。空格用來交代標示方式，要讓消費者能清楚辨識產地，避免誤導。因此使用副詞 clearly，而不是形容詞 clear、名詞 clarity 或比較級 clearer。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: clear 可作形容詞或動詞，但 must clear display the country of origin 無法形成此處「清楚標示產地」的句構。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: clearly 是副詞，放在 display 前修飾標示方式，符合避免誤導顧客的目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: clarity 是名詞，表示清晰度；此處不是命名某項特質，而是修飾 display 的動作。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: clearer 是形容詞比較級；它不能在本句中直接修飾 display 這個動詞，也沒有對應的比較結構。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 助動詞後仍可在主要動詞前放方式副詞；must clearly display 表示必須清楚標示。

questions.prompt: The packaging design has {{q24}} approval, pending the shipping trials; any damage found during those trials will require a fresh application.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 provisional；目前的核准只是暫時性的，仍須等待運送測試結果。
explanation.reasoning_zh: pending the shipping trials 表示運送測試尚待進行，後面又明說只要測試發現損壞，就必須重新申請。這不是已無待確認事項的最終核准，而是可能隨測試結果改變的暫時核准。provisional 最符合這個尚未定案的階段。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: definitive 表示最終確定的；本句仍在等待運送測試，且可能須重新申請，因此不宜把目前的核准描述為最終定案。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: unconditional 表示無條件的；核准能否繼續有效，明確受到運送測試不得發現損壞的條件限制。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: irrevocable 表示不可撤回的；測試若發現損壞就須重新申請，並非一項已保證不可撤回的核准。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: provisional 表示暫時核准、尚待確認；它準確反映等待測試且可能重新申請的狀態。

explanation.takeaway_zh: provisional 常形容尚待測試或確認的暫時安排；留意 pending 及後續條件是否顯示尚未定案。

questions.prompt: {{q25}} the subscription includes unlimited storage, accounts remain subject to the service's rules on prohibited content and unauthorized file sharing.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 Although，後接完整子句，表達無限儲存空間仍受使用規範限制的讓步關係。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後的 the subscription includes unlimited storage 包含主詞與有限動詞，是完整子句。Although 可以直接引出這個讓步子句，再與 accounts remain subject to ... 的主句連接。Despite 與 In spite of 雖也表示讓步，卻不能直接接此處現成的完整子句。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Despite 是介系詞；若保留本句主詞與動詞，需要改用 despite the fact that 等結構，不能直接接 the subscription includes。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: During 是介系詞，表示某段期間；本句後接的是完整子句，而且要表達的是讓步而非期間。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Although 是從屬連接詞，可直接接完整子句，表示即使提供無限空間，帳戶仍受內容及分享規範約束。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: In spite of 是介系詞片語；它可接名詞或動名詞片語，但不能直接接本句的完整主詞與謂語。

explanation.takeaway_zh: although 加完整子句；despite 與 in spite of 通常加名詞或動名詞片語，不能僅憑中文意思互換。

questions.prompt: The replacement lockers at the fitness center are sufficiently {{q26}} to hold a gym bag without folding or squeezing it.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 spacious，形容健身中心的新置物櫃足夠寬敞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: are 後需要表達 lockers 狀態的補語，sufficiently 則表示「足夠地」，修飾形容詞 spacious。sufficiently spacious to hold a gym bag 表示寬敞到足以容納運動袋，後面的 without folding or squeezing it 進一步說明所需空間。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: spacious 是形容詞，表示寬敞的；are sufficiently spacious to hold ... 正確描述置物櫃的容量。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: spaciousness 是名詞，表示寬敞這項性質；are sufficiently spaciousness 無法構成本句的程度與狀態結構。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: spaciously 是副詞；此處沒有要由它修飾的動作，are 後要表達的是置物櫃寬敞的狀態。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: space 是名詞或動詞；本句不是在名詞前作修飾，而是需要 sufficiently 後能表示寬敞程度的形容詞。

explanation.takeaway_zh: be sufficiently 加形容詞再接 to 不定詞，可表達某種程度已足以完成後面的用途。

questions.prompt: The training coordinator will contact employees {{q27}} supervisors have approved their applications and send them instructions for accessing the online course.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 whose，表達「這些員工的主管」已核准申請的所有關係。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後的 supervisors 是關係子句的主詞，have approved 是謂語，their applications 是受詞。因此空格不是補另一個主詞或受詞，而是限定 supervisors 屬於前面的哪些 employees。whose supervisors 表示「其主管」，以所有關係把子句接回員工。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 可在其他關係子句中指物，但此處需要的是 employees 與 supervisors 之間的所有關係，which supervisors 不能構成所需結構。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 是關係代名詞的受格；子句已有 their applications 作受詞，且本句要限定 supervisors 的所屬，不能用 whom。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 可充當關係子句的主詞或部分用法中的受詞，但不能直接在此充當 supervisors 前表示「員工的」的所有格限定語。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 是關係詞的所有格形式，whose supervisors 表示這些員工的主管，後面的子句成分完整。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 關係子句已有主詞與受詞時，若空格要放在名詞前表達先行詞與該名詞的所屬關係，可檢查 whose。

questions.prompt: Our rental assistants can verify your equipment selection if you send {{q28}} a copy of the reservation form before pickup.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 them，作為 send 的間接受詞，指前面提到的租賃服務人員。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 條件子句的主詞是 you，send 後面接收件人與寄送物品，結構為 send someone a copy。收件人是前句的 rental assistants，因此用受格 them。a copy of the reservation form 已是寄送的物品，不能把所有格形式直接放在它前面代替收件人。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: their 是所有格限定詞，須與它所限定的名詞組合；their a copy 的順序不成立，也沒有表達 send 所需的收件人。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: them 是受格，回指複數的 rental assistants，並在 send them a copy 中作間接受詞，表示把副本寄給他們。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: theirs 是所有代名詞，雖然可在其他句子中作受詞，但本句沒有可由「他們的某物」代表的收件人；要指服務人員本人應用 them。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: themselves 是反身代名詞；本子句寄送者是 you，收件者是另一群租賃人員，並非同一主體回指自身，因此此處應用 them。

explanation.takeaway_zh: send someone something 中，收件人若用人稱代名詞，須看受格與正確指涉，不能只看它位於動詞後。

questions.prompt: The books arrived after last month's author visit; if the independent bookshop had ordered sooner, the distributor {{q29}} them before the event.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 would have delivered，表示若當時更早訂書，本來可在上個月的作家到訪前送達。
explanation.reasoning_zh: The books arrived after last month's author visit 明示書籍在上個月作家到訪之後才到貨，這是已發生的過去結果。後半句改設更早訂購的情況，並把送達時間改為活動前，與實際結果相反。因此使用 would have delivered，表達在這個過去假設下本來會實現的送達結果。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: will deliver 表示未來配送；本句的 the event 指上個月已舉行的作家到訪，無法把該活動之前的送達寫成尚待發生的未來結果。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: would have delivered 表示當時若較早訂購，本來會在作家到訪前送達；這個未實現的過去結果與實際在活動後到貨形成對照。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: has delivered 是現在完成式，陳述已完成的配送；題目已明說實際到貨在活動後，不能再把活動前已送達當成真實完成的結果，此處需要表達假設結果。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: is delivering 可描述現在進行或已安排的配送；本句要假設的是在上個月活動之前本可完成的送達，並非現在進行或未來已安排的行動。

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷過去假設時，先確認明示事實與活動時間；would have 加過去分詞可表達與實際過去不同的假設結果。

questions.prompt: At the recycling depot, {{q30}} of the paper bins is weighed separately and assigned an identification number before being returned to its owner.

explanation.summary_zh: 選 each；each of the paper bins 可搭配單數 is，表示逐一處理每個紙類回收桶。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 空格後已有 of the paper bins，因此要選能直接接這個 of 片語的數量詞。each of 加複數名詞可作單數主詞，與 is weighed、its owner 一致，並呼應 separately 所說的逐一秤重與編號。every 不能直接套入這個 of 結構，all 與 both 則不能與此處的 is 搭配。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: each 可直接接 of the paper bins，整個主詞表示其中每一個桶，在本句搭配單數 is 並逐一分配編號。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: every 在這個意思下通常直接限定單數名詞，例如 every paper bin；不能原封不動寫成 every of the paper bins。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: all of the paper bins 指所有這些複數的桶，若作本句主詞，應搭配 are weighed，而不是題目已有的 is weighed。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: both of the paper bins 指兩個桶，作主詞時須搭配 are；本句的單數 is 因而排除 both，且題目也未限定總數為二。

explanation.takeaway_zh: each of 加複數名詞可作單數主詞；every 通常直接接單數名詞，兩者不能只按中文「每個」互換。

content.title: Merrow Business Awards: Schedule Correction
content.scenario_summary: An awards coordinator corrects an erroneous ceremony date and explains which email finalists should use, and when they must reply, to have a corrected company name printed on their certificates before the event.

blocks.text: From: Cora Vale, Awards Coordinator
To: Merrow Business Awards finalists
Subject: Corrected ceremony date
Dear finalists,
My May 4 email listed July 10 as the date of the Merrow Business Awards ceremony. The correct date is July 17; the venue and starting time are unchanged. This notice {{q1}} the earlier schedule.
Mara Reed, {{q2}} coordinates finalist arrangements, will handle any correction requests.

Your entry confirmation accepts replies, whereas the automated portrait notice comes from an address that cannot receive mail. Use just one of these messages to request a company-name correction: reply to {{q3}}.
We will finalize the certificate file on July 8. Requests received later will be processed after the ceremony. {{q4}} That way, your corrected certificate will be ready when you arrive.

Regards,
Cora Vale

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 新通知更正典禮日期，將取代先前的時程資訊。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前文先指出舊郵件寫成 July 10，再明確更正為 July 17，因此新通知與舊時程之間是「取代」的關係。supersedes 表示新資訊取代舊資訊、成為應依循的版本；其他選項都無法表達這項更正。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: reaffirms 是「再次確認、重申」。此處明確否定舊郵件中的日期，並非再次確認舊時程。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: supersedes 是「取代」。新通知把典禮日期更正為 July 17，取代先前含有錯誤日期的時程。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: duplicates 是「複製、重複」。新通知提供不同的典禮日期，並不是照樣複製舊時程。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: reinstates 是「恢復、重新實施」。通知要求採用更正後的日期，而不是恢復先前的錯誤日期。

evidence.quote: My May 4 email listed July 10 as the date of the Merrow Business Awards ceremony. The correct date is July 17; the venue and starting time are unchanged. This notice {{q1}} the earlier schedule.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷新舊資訊的關係時，先看前文是確認、修正，還是恢復舊內容。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 關係子句修飾 Mara Reed，空格須作 coordinates 的主詞。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 逗號之間的關係子句補充說明 Mara Reed 的職務。coordinates 前缺少主詞，且先行詞是人，因此用主格關係代名詞 who。主句則是 Mara Reed will handle any correction requests。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: whom 用於關係子句中的受詞位置；此處空格須直接擔任 coordinates 的主詞，不能用 whom。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: whose 表示所屬關係，通常接所修飾的名詞；此處後面直接接動詞 coordinates，缺少所屬名詞，不合句型。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: which 通常用於指物或整件事情的關係子句；此處補充說明的是 Mara Reed 這個人，應使用 who。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: who 指前面的 Mara Reed，並在關係子句中作 coordinates 的主詞，句型與指涉均正確。

evidence.quote: Mara Reed, {{q2}} coordinates finalist arrangements, will handle any correction requests.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷關係代名詞時，須同時確認先行詞及其在子句中的主詞、受詞或所有格角色。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 可接收回覆的是先提到的報名確認郵件，因此選 the former。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前一句依序提到 entry confirmation 與 automated portrait notice，並說明前者接受回覆、後者的寄件地址無法收信。本句又要求只使用其中一封提出名稱更正，因此應回覆前者，即 the former。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: the former 指兩者中先提到的 entry confirmation；前句明說這封確認郵件接受回覆，適合提出更正。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: the latter 指後提到的 automated portrait notice；其寄件地址無法收信，回覆它不能送達更正要求。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: both 表示兩封都回覆，與 Use just one 的單一管道要求衝突，而且攝影通知的寄件地址無法收信。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: neither 表示兩封都不回覆，與本句要求使用其中一封提出更正的指示衝突。

evidence.quote: Your entry confirmation accepts replies, whereas the automated portrait notice comes from an address that cannot receive mail. Use just one of these messages to request a company-name correction: reply to {{q3}}.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 遇到 the former／the latter，先找出前文兩個對象的提及順序，再核對各自的功能。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Submit your name correction by replying to your entry confirmation after the certificate file is finalized.

options.label: B
options.text: Submit your name correction by replying to the portrait notice before the certificate file is finalized.

options.label: C
options.text: Submit your name correction by replying to your entry confirmation before the certificate file is finalized.

options.label: D
options.text: Submit your name correction by replying to the portrait notice after the certificate file is finalized.

explanation.summary_zh: 要在抵達前完成更正，須及時回覆可收信的報名確認郵件。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 本題須同時核對聯絡管道與時間。前段說確認郵件可回覆、攝影通知無法收信；本段則說檔案定稿後才收到的要求，須等典禮結束後處理。只有在檔案定稿前回覆確認郵件，才能承接後句「抵達時更正後的證書就會備妥」的結果。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 回覆確認郵件的管道正確，但 after 表示在檔案定稿後才寄出；這類要求會等典禮後處理，無法使證書在抵達時備妥。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: before 符合提前處理的時間條件，但 portrait notice 的寄件地址不能收信，無法藉此提出更正。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 同時符合兩項條件：回覆可收信的 entry confirmation，並在證書檔案定稿前提出要求，因此能銜接後句的事先備妥。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項同時弄錯管道與時間：攝影通知無法收信，而且檔案定稿後的更正要等典禮後處理，無法提前完成。

evidence.quote: Your entry confirmation accepts replies, whereas the automated portrait notice comes from an address that cannot receive mail.
We will finalize the certificate file on July 8. Requests received later will be processed after the ceremony. {{q4}} That way, your corrected certificate will be ready when you arrive.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 整句填空須同時滿足前文的操作條件與後文的結果，不能只看主題是否相關。

content.title: Home Retailer Follows Up on Unfinished Returns
content.scenario_summary: A home-goods retailer follows up with shoppers who began an online return but did not choose a pickup date. Staff may explain the calendar, but customers must make the selection; completing the request does not itself authorize a refund.

documents.title: Home retailer follows up on unfinished returns

blocks.text: Home retailer follows up on unfinished returns

Customers of Elmridge Home who began an online return but left the pickup date blank are being contacted this week. {{q1}} The message directs them back to their unfinished request, where they can select an available date.
At a briefing for warehouse staff, returns manager Leena Park said employees could explain the calendar but could not select dates for customers. "The final decision is {{q2}}," she told the staff.

A saved request remains {{q3}} until a pickup date has been selected. Submitting the missing date completes the request. {{q4}}, it does not guarantee a refund: the store must first inspect the returned item.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

options.label: A
options.text: The retailer is asking them to start a fresh return request by telephone.

options.label: B
options.text: The retailer is confirming pickup dates that its delivery team has selected.

options.label: C
options.text: The retailer is asking them to await mailed notices assigning their pickup dates.

options.label: D
options.text: The retailer is emailing them a link to the request they have already saved.

explanation.summary_zh: 後句說郵件引導顧客返回未完成的申請，須先交代寄送連結。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文章先交代這些顧客已開始線上退貨申請，但尚未選取收件日期。空格後的 The message 指向一則聯絡訊息，並說該訊息讓顧客返回原來未完成的申請。因此，寄送已儲存申請的連結可同時銜接前後文。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項要求重新以電話提出申請；後句卻說返回既有、尚未完成的申請，兩者的申請方式與是否重開申請不同。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項說日期已由送貨團隊選好；後句仍要求顧客自行選日期，後文也明說員工不能代選。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項要求等待郵寄通知日期；後句則描述顧客藉訊息返回線上申請並自行選日期，並非等待日期通知。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 寄送已儲存申請的連結，正好使下一句的 The message 有所指，並說明顧客如何返回未完成的申請。

evidence.quote: Customers of Elmridge Home who began an online return but left the pickup date blank are being contacted this week. {{q1}} The message directs them back to their unfinished request, where they can select an available date.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 整句填空要確認後句的指稱來源，並維持流程中「既有申請」與「新申請」的差別。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 決定權屬於顧客，經理對員工說話時應以 theirs 指稱顧客。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 四個選項都是可單獨作補語的所有格代名詞，須依說話者與聽話者判斷。Park 正對倉庫員工說明規則：員工可解釋行事曆，但不能替顧客選日期。因此，決定權屬於 customers，應以第三人稱複數的 theirs 表示。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: ours 表示「我們的」，在經理對員工說話的情境中會把決定權歸給經理與員工一方；前文卻說員工不得代顧客選日期。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: theirs 表示「他們的」，指前文的 customers。顧客自行決定日期，符合員工僅能協助說明的限制。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: yours 表示「你們的」。引言明確是對 warehouse staff 說的，會把決定權交給員工，與前文規則衝突。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: mine 表示「我的」，會把決定權歸給說話的退貨部經理 Park；她正在說明員工不能替顧客決定，而非表示由自己代選。

evidence.quote: At a briefing for warehouse staff, returns manager Leena Park said employees could explain the calendar but could not select dates for customers. "The final decision is {{q2}}," she told the staff.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 引言中的所有格代名詞須依說話者、聽話者及第三方的實際角色判斷，不能只看最近的名詞。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 缺少必要的收件日期，申請仍屬於 incomplete（未完成）。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文章一開始說顧客留下空白的收件日期，後面又明說提交日期便完成申請。尚未選日期時，申請的狀態就是 incomplete；尚不能稱為 complete，文中也沒有取消申請或超過期限的情況。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: incomplete 是「未完成的」。日期尚未選定，仍有一步待完成，且後句明說補上日期即可完成申請。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: complete 是「已完成的」。後句明說要提交缺少的日期才完成申請，因此在選定日期前不能描述為 complete。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: canceled 是「已取消的」。文中描述的是可繼續補填的既有申請，沒有取消申請的動作或通知。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: overdue 是「逾期的」。缺少日期不等於超過期限；文中未說這些申請已超過規定的截止時間。

evidence.quote: A saved request remains {{q3}} until a pickup date has been selected. Submitting the missing date completes the request.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分流程狀態：缺少必要步驟是未完成，並不自動表示已取消或逾期。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 完成申請仍不保證退款，兩句之間須用 However 表示轉折。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句說補上日期即可完成申請，後句則限制這項結果的意義：完成申請不代表保證退款，店家仍須先檢查退貨商品。However 可表達這種「流程完成，但結果尚未確定」的轉折。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: For instance 表示「例如」，但不保證退款並不是完成申請的一個例子，而是在說明完成申請的效力有限。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Consequently 表示「因此」。不能保證退款不是因為填完日期而產生的結果；後句是在補充退款另有檢查條件。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: However 表示「然而」，可將完成申請與尚未保證退款的限制連接起來，符合兩句的邏輯關係。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: In other words 表示「換句話說」。完成申請與不保證退款不是同一內容的改述，後句增加了前句未包含的限制。

evidence.quote: Submitting the missing date completes the request. {{q4}}, it does not guarantee a refund: the store must first inspect the returned item.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 連接詞須反映兩句的實際關係；達成流程的一步，仍可能受到後續條件限制。

content.title: Carron Gazette Directory Artwork Requirements
content.scenario_summary: A local newspaper increases the required width of directory advertisements while preserving an exemption for unchanged files approved before a cutoff. The notice explains the exemption's version restriction and the resizing needed to bring 80-millimeter files into conformity with the 90-millimeter specification.

documents.title: New artwork width for directory advertisements

blocks.text: New artwork width for directory advertisements

Starting with the November edition, Community Directory advertisements in the Carron Gazette must be 90 millimeters wide rather than 80 millimeters. The height remains 50 millimeters. The change will {{q1}} into effect on November 1.
Files approved before October 25 may use the previous width if their wording and images remain unchanged. {{q2}} The exemption covers the approved version itself, not later revisions.
Several advertisers have submitted 80-millimeter files that are still awaiting approval. To meet the new requirement, these files must be {{q3}}.
Please {{q4}} our advertising desk for help with file preparation.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 主詞是變更本身，應用 come into effect 表示開始生效。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 此句說明新尺寸規定何時開始生效，主詞 The change 是生效的事項，因此用 come into effect。bring／put something into effect 則表示某個行動者實施某項措施，需要另有受詞；不能直接套入本句的 The change will ___ into effect。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: bring something into effect 可表示使某措施生效，但此句沒有 bring 所需的受詞，主詞也是變更本身，不能直接填 bring。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: place 在「把某物置於某種狀態」的用法中須接受詞；本句不是某人把措施付諸實行，而是變更本身開始生效。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: come into effect 是「開始生效」。The change will come into effect on November 1 正確表達新規定於該日生效。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: put something into effect 表示將某措施付諸實行，須有受詞 something；此處 will put 後直接接 into effect，句型不完整。

evidence.quote: The change will {{q1}} into effect on November 1.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 區分「措施本身生效」的 come into effect 與「實施某措施」的 put something into effect。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

options.label: A
options.text: Revisions to an approved advertisement must retain its original dimensions, even if the wording or images change.

options.label: B
options.text: Changing the wording or images of an approved advertisement requires a file at the new width.

options.label: C
options.text: A wider file is needed only when both the wording and the images of an approved advertisement are changed.

options.label: D
options.text: A wider file is needed only when an approved advertisement's images change; wording changes are exempt.

explanation.summary_zh: 舊尺寸豁免僅適用未變動的已核准版本；改文字或圖片都須用新寬度。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句允許特定已核准檔案沿用舊寬度，但附帶文字與圖片均保持不變的條件。後句又限定豁免只涵蓋核准版本，不包含後續修改。因此，只要文字或圖片任一項改變，修改版就必須採用新寬度；不是兩項都改才適用。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項要求修改版仍保留原尺寸，卻與「豁免不涵蓋後續修改」衝突；有修改時不能援用這項舊寬度豁免。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: wording or images 表示文字或圖片任一項改變，皆須提交新寬度的檔案，符合前句的不變條件與後句的版本限制。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: only when both 把新寬度要求縮限為文字與圖片同時改變才適用；原文要求兩者都保持不變才能沿用舊寬度，單改一項也會失去豁免。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項把純文字修改列為豁免，但前句要求 wording 也須保持不變，後句並未給文字修改任何例外。

evidence.quote: Files approved before October 25 may use the previous width if their wording and images remain unchanged. {{q2}} The exemption covers the approved version itself, not later revisions.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 追蹤豁免條件的適用範圍：要求兩項都不變，表示改其中任一項便不再符合。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 為符合新的 90 公釐寬度要求，80 公釐寬的檔案須調整尺寸。
explanation.reasoning_zh: These files 指前句的 80 公釐寬檔案，new requirement 是前文規定的 90 公釐寬。To meet 明確表示本句的目的：若要讓這些檔案達到新寬度，就需要 resized，亦即調整尺寸。判斷依據是尺寸差異與句中目的，不能只憑待核准狀態認定檔案已失去豁免機會。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: retained 是「保留」。保留檔案本身不會把 80 公釐寬調整為 90 公釐，無法表達為符合新規格所必需的尺寸變更。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: translated 是「翻譯」。本通知處理的是寬度規格，並未要求改變廣告使用的語言；翻譯也不會使檔案符合新寬度。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: duplicated 是「複製」。複製一份仍為 80 公釐寬的檔案不會改變其尺寸，無法解決規格不符的問題。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: resized 是「重新調整尺寸」。這句明說要符合新要求，因此須將 80 公釐寬改為 90 公釐；此選項能表達所需的尺寸變更。

Files approved before October 25 may use the previous width if their wording and images remain unchanged.
Several advertisers have submitted 80-millimeter files that are still awaiting approval. To meet the new requirement, these files must be {{q3}}.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 這是以 Please 開頭的祈使句，主要動詞應用原形 contact。

option_analysis.label: C

content.title: Linden Relocations Customer Review
content.scenario_summary: A studio reviews a moving company after a delayed lift inspection leads its landlord to extend the office-vacating deadline by three days. The movers honor the revised completion time and transfer the reservation without increasing the original price.

documents.title: A flexible crew for our office move

blocks.text: A flexible crew for our office move
Reviewed by Evan Cho, Northbank Studio

A lift inspection delayed access to our new office until June 4. Our landlord extended the deadline for leaving the old office from June 3 to June 6, and Linden Relocations promised to finish the move by 6 P.M. that day.
The crew {{q1}} that commitment: at 5 P.M. on June 6, I signed for the last box at our new office. By then, they {{q2}} all of our office furniture and equipment.
I had worried that changing the booking would mean extra charges. {{q3}} Our only invoice matched the original quote exactly, with no additional charges.
Overall, I was {{q4}} with Linden's service and would hire the company again.

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q1}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 搬家公司在延後的期限之前完成工作，確實履行了新的承諾。
explanation.reasoning_zh: that commitment 指前段承諾在 June 6 下午六點前完成搬遷，而非原本 June 3 的遷出期限。評論者在 June 6 下午五點已簽收最後一箱，家具設備也已送達，說明公司履行了更新後的承諾。live up to a commitment 表示達到承諾所要求的表現。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: went back on a commitment 是「違背承諾」。公司承諾下午六點前完成，實際下午五點即已送達全部物品，後文不能支持違約的說法。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: backed away from a commitment 是「退縮、不再承擔承諾」。後面冒號提供的事實是在約定時間前完成，並非退出承諾。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: fell short of a commitment 是「未達到承諾」。比較時應使用延後後的 June 6 下午六點，而不能因超過原本 June 3 就判定未達要求。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: lived up to a commitment 是「履行、達到承諾」。下午五點已完成交付，早於更新後的下午六點期限，符合這項搭配與上下文。

evidence.quote: Our landlord extended the deadline for leaving the old office from June 3 to June 6, and Linden Relocations promised to finish the move by 6 P.M. that day.
The crew {{q1}} that commitment: at 5 P.M. on June 6, I signed for the last box at our new office. By then, they {{q2}} all of our office furniture and equipment.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷承諾是否履行時，須先找出目前有效的承諾內容，再比較實際完成時間。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q2}}.

explanation.summary_zh: By then 回指過去的簽收時點，先完成的交付用 had delivered。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 評論者先以過去式 signed 敘述 June 6 下午五點簽收最後一箱。By then 指到那個過去時點為止，家具與設備的交付已經完成；在所給選項中，過去完成式 had delivered 能表達這個時間先後關係。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: having delivered 是完成分詞形式，不能單獨構成這個敘述句的主要動詞。本句以 they 為主詞，且沒有其他限定動詞；填入此形式會使句子缺少完整的主句述語。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: had delivered 是過去完成式，表示在過去的下午五點簽收時點之前，家具與設備已全部送達，符合 By then 的回指。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: have delivered 是現在完成式，以現在為參照；此句明確以過去的簽收時點為參照，因此不適合這裡的時間安排。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: are delivering 是現在進行式，描述現在正在交付；本段在回顧過去且交付已完成，並不是敘述此刻進行中的工作。

evidence.quote: at 5 P.M. on June 6, I signed for the last box at our new office. By then, they {{q2}} all of our office furniture and equipment.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 先找 then 回指的時間，再判斷動作相對於該時點是已完成、進行中或尚未發生。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q3}}.

options.label: A
options.text: The company kept both dates on our reservation and charged us for both.

options.label: B
options.text: The company moved our reservation to June 6 and added a rescheduling fee.

options.label: C
options.text: The company transferred our reservation to June 6 at the originally quoted price.

options.label: D
options.text: The company canceled our original reservation and charged a higher price to rebook.

explanation.summary_zh: 帳單與原報價完全相同且無加收費用，表示改期維持原價。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 前句提出擔憂：改期可能產生額外費用。後句明確說唯一的帳單與原報價完全相同，沒有任何追加費用。因此，空格須說明公司將預約轉到新日期並維持原價，才能形成擔憂獲得解決、再以帳單佐證的敘述。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項說原日期與新日期都被收費；後句卻明說帳單完全符合原報價且沒有追加費用，不能支持雙重收費。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項說加收改期費，直接與後句的 no additional charges 衝突。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項將預約移至 June 6 並維持原報價，既回應前句的加價疑慮，也符合後句實際收到的帳單。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 此選項說重新預約被收取更高的價格；後句卻說金額與原報價完全相同，並未提高。

evidence.quote: I had worried that changing the booking would mean extra charges. {{q3}} Our only invoice matched the original quote exactly, with no additional charges.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 用前句的問題與後句的結果夾定整句填空，尤其留意是否明確加收費用。

questions.prompt: Choose the best answer for blank {{q4}}.

explanation.summary_zh: 評論者肯定準時完成且不加價，並願意再次聘用，應是 satisfied。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 全文描述公司履行新的完成期限，改期也沒有增加費用，末句更說願意再次聘用。這些都是正面的服務評價，因此應用 satisfied，表示對服務感到滿意。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: satisfied 是「滿意的」，符合前文對準時交付與維持原價的肯定，也銜接願意再次聘用的結論。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: disappointed 是「失望的」。本篇未提出服務未達期待之處，反而強調履約並願意再聘用，與失望的評價不符。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: frustrated 是「感到挫折、懊惱的」。文中原先的時間與費用疑慮都獲得解決，末句也給出正面再聘用意願，不支持這種負面總評。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: dissatisfied 是「不滿意的」。這與已述的正面服務結果及 would hire the company again 的意願相反。

evidence.quote: Our only invoice matched the original quote exactly, with no additional charges.
Overall, I was {{q4}} with Linden's service and would hire the company again.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 評價用字須與全文的具體結果及最後的行動意願保持一致。

content.title: Calden Panel Replacement-Lid Notice
content.scenario_summary: A customer-research panel offers replacement lids for one coded batch of travel mugs being tested. Participants exchange the original lid using their sample card, keep the mug at home, and continue the same usage log while recording when they change lids.

documents.title: Replacement lids for the travel-mug trial

blocks.text: Replacement lids for the travel-mug trial
Calden Customer Research Panel
Collection: November 6–8, 9 A.M.–5 P.M.
Some lids supplied with our trial travel mugs may leak. Replacement lids are now available for samples with codes beginning TM4. This notice applies to panel members currently testing those samples.
Exchange your original lid at our research desk, 42 Alder Street. Show the sample card packed with your mug so staff can identify its code. Keep the mug at home; the new lid fits the same mug.
The exchange is free. Continue your existing usage log and enter the date you first use the replacement lid. The trial will still end on November 15.
If you cannot visit during the collection hours, email panel@calden.example to arrange an exchange by post.

content.title: Norwell Studio Brush-Set Review
content.scenario_summary: An art teacher pilots six brush sets in one class before making a larger replacement purchase. The review evaluates comfortable handles, easy cleaning, shape retention and useful pouches, and reports plans to buy more despite the relatively high price.

documents.title: Good brushes for a busy teaching studio

blocks.text: Good brushes for a busy teaching studio
4 out of 5 stars — Mira Tan, Cedar Art Room

My beginner classes change techniques every week, so brushes must handle both thin watercolor washes and thicker poster paint. I ordered six Norwell Studio brush sets to try in one Saturday class before replacing supplies for all four groups.

The short trial went well. The handles remained comfortable through a two-hour session, and the bristles came clean with soap and water without losing their shape. Each set arrived in a zippered pouch, which stopped loose brushes getting mixed together in our classroom boxes. Delivery took three days, exactly as promised.
At $12 a set, these are not the cheapest choice. We plan to order another 24 sets next month because the easier cleanup saved class time.

Elin Voss

option_analysis.label: C

evidence.quote: The organizers started a booth-relief service this morning. An assistant can watch your stand for 20 minutes while you take a break.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷聊天開場目的時，先看發起者介紹的服務或提出的需求，不要把後續背景話題誤當主旨。

questions.prompt: At 11:09, what does Jon Vale mean when he writes, "My sandwich and I would appreciate that."?

option_analysis.label: C

evidence.quote: There's a 12:30 slot available. Shall I reserve it for you?

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷話語意圖時，先找它正在回應哪一項提議；幽默的感謝也可能是在間接接受。

content.title: Merehaven Hotel Breakfast-Schedule Chat

blocks.speaker: Dara Mills

option_analysis.label: A

option_analysis.label: C

option_analysis.label: D

evidence.quote: The card in my room says breakfast starts at 6:30, but the app says 7:30. Which time applies tomorrow?

content.title: Furniture Retailer Tests Evening Deliveries
content.scenario_summary: A furniture retailer is piloting evening delivery slots in one district while retaining its daytime network. It will use delivery records and customer feedback to assess interest, and compare first-attempt completion rates before considering a wider service.

blocks.text: Furniture Retailer Tests Evening Deliveries
Westfield Business Journal | September 3, 2027

Bellwether Furnishings will begin a six-week trial of evening deliveries on September 20. Two crews will serve customers in the Eastbank district between 6:00 and 9:00 P.M. on Tuesdays and Thursdays. The retailer’s regular daytime service will continue across the city.

Operations manager Mina Sorell said the idea emerged from customer feedback. “People tell us that taking time away from work to receive furniture is difficult,” she said. “We need reliable results before changing the whole network.” Customers can reserve the trial slots through the company’s existing website, and the standard delivery fee will apply.

The company will use delivery records and a short customer survey to gauge interest in a permanent evening service. Managers will also compare the proportion of deliveries completed on the first attempt with figures from daytime routes. They will review both sets of findings before deciding whether to offer evening appointments in other districts.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: To introduce a new range of office furniture

options.label: B
options.text: To recruit drivers for a citywide delivery network

options.label: C
options.text: To report on a retailer’s test of a different delivery schedule

options.label: D
options.text: To announce the opening of a furniture warehouse

explanation.summary_zh: 文章報導家具零售商試辦夜間配送，以及如何評估試辦成果。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 首段公布六週的夜間配送試辦，接著交代推出原因、預約方式與費用，最後說明評估資料及是否擴及其他區域的決策。C 涵蓋了整篇報導的重點。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章談的是家具配送時段，沒有介紹新的辦公家具產品系列。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中提到兩組配送人員，但沒有徵才要求；這次試辦也僅限 Eastbank 區，並非招募全市配送網的人員。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。報導說明業者試行不同配送時段的內容、原因與後續評估方式。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章沒有新倉庫開幕的資訊；使用的是既有網站，服務變動則是配送時段。

evidence.quote: Bellwether Furnishings will begin a six-week trial of evening deliveries on September 20.
They will review both sets of findings before deciding whether to offer evening appointments in other districts.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 新聞主旨題要把宣布的措施與後續評估連在一起，避免把人員或網站等配角細節當成主題。

questions.prompt: Which measure will managers compare between the trial and the regular service?

options.label: A
options.text: The average price of the furniture delivered

options.label: B
options.text: The number of employees requesting daytime shifts

options.label: C
options.text: The standard fee charged for each delivery

options.label: D
options.text: The share of deliveries completed without a second visit

explanation.summary_zh: 管理人員會比較第一次配送就成功完成的比例。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 最後一段明確說要比較 the proportion of deliveries completed on the first attempt 與日間路線的數據。D 的 share 對應 proportion，without a second visit 則改寫第一次就完成、無須再次到訪的意思。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章沒有提到比較所配送家具的平均售價；評估重點是服務表現與客戶興趣。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 兩組人員參與夜間試辦，但沒有說要統計或比較員工申請日班的人數。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 標準配送費會適用於試辦，但文中沒有把費用列為兩種服務要比較的指標。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。第一次到訪就完成的配送比例，正是文中與日間路線數據比較的項目。

evidence.quote: Managers will also compare the proportion of deliveries completed on the first attempt with figures from daytime routes.
the standard delivery fee will apply.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 細節題常以比例或流程的同義改寫出題；first attempt 對應第一次完成，proportion 可改寫為 share。

questions.prompt: The word "gauge" in the article is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: gauge interest 在此表示評估客戶對常態夜間配送服務的興趣。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 公司利用配送紀錄與簡短問卷蒐集資訊，目的是了解客戶對常態夜間配送的興趣程度。assess 可放回 to assess interest，保留原句的語法與評估語意。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: increase 是提高。原句是在蒐集資料以了解興趣程度，並不是說用紀錄與問卷來增加興趣。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。assess interest 表示評估興趣程度，符合以紀錄和問卷判斷需求的語境。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: retain 是保留或維持。這裡尚在評估常態服務是否有需求，並非描述維持既有興趣的措施。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: announce 是宣布。原句說明公司如何了解客戶興趣，不是在公布某項興趣調查結果。

evidence.quote: The company will use delivery records and a short customer survey to gauge interest in a permanent evening service.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 字義題可由動作的工具與目的判斷；用紀錄和問卷了解需求，對應評估而非增加或宣布。

content.title: A Revised Volunteer Shift
content.scenario_summary: A clothing-donation delivery is delayed by a vehicle fault. Volunteers use the waiting period to prepare welcome envelopes, leaving them unsealed for the coordinator’s contact cards, and wait for their table to be called before helping with unloading.

blocks.text: Northgate Family Centre: Morning Volunteer Shift — Revised Plan
October 5, 2027 | Clothing Donation Program
The truck carrying this morning’s clothing donations has developed a mechanical fault. It is now expected at 11:30 A.M. Please follow the revised plan below while we wait.
Sign in at the side entrance and collect your table number. Go to the workroom, where envelope materials are already laid out.

Prepare welcome packets for next month’s volunteers. Place one centre map and one program leaflet in each envelope. Keep the envelopes unsealed. The coordinator will collect the completed boxes later and add contact cards after confirming the centre’s new phone numbers.
Once you finish your table’s batch, tell the team leader and put the box of unsealed envelopes on the marked shelf. Do not start another batch unless the leader asks you to.
When the clothing truck arrives, stay in the workroom until the coordinator calls your table number. The called team will help move bags from the unloading area to the sorting stations.

options.label: A
options.text: To invite residents to donate clothing for a future volunteer event

options.label: B
options.text: To organize volunteer work while a donation delivery is delayed

options.label: C
options.text: To explain the training required to become a volunteer team leader

explanation.reasoning_zh: 開頭說明載運衣物的貨車故障、預計較晚送達，接著安排報到、製作歡迎資料袋及到貨後依組別搬運。整份內容是在因應延誤調整當班工作，因此選 B。

option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中的 next month 指歡迎資料袋要提供給下個月的志工，並非邀請居民為未來活動捐衣。

option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。貨車延誤是調整原因，後續步驟則說明等待期間及到貨後各自要做的事。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 組長在流程中接受完成通知並指派工作，但文中沒有說明如何接受培訓或成為組長。

option_analysis.label: D

content.title: Bramble Community Garden Application Letter
content.scenario_summary: A garden secretary explains residency eligibility and distinguishes three optional activities from the compulsory address-verification session. The recipient will miss an optional open session while traveling but returns before both the application deadline and the required verification date.

documents.title: Your enquiry about the Bramble plot draw

blocks.text: March 15, 2027
Dear Ms. Soren,
Thank you for your interest in Bramble Community Garden. You mentioned that you will be away April 2–4, returning April 5, and asked which events applicants must attend.

Applicants must be at least 18 and have their main home in Bramble Ward. Owning property or working here without living here does not satisfy the residency requirement. Submit the online application by April 8.
The open session on April 3 offers a chance to see the plots and meet current gardeners. It is optional, and missing it does not affect an application. [[1]]
Volunteers will offer help with the online form at the library on April 6. This drop-in session is also optional; applicants may complete the form independently. [[2]]
After the April 20 draw, successful applicants may attend a welcome session on April 26. Their plots remain assigned whether or not they attend. [[3]]

One visit is required: all applicants must attend the address-verification session at the community hall on April 12, between 9 A.M. and noon. [[4]] Please bring an original current utility bill or rental agreement showing your name and main home address.

Sincerely,
Pavel Reed
Secretary, Bramble Community Garden

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the letter?

options.label: A
options.text: To confirm that a particular garden plot has been reserved for Ms. Soren

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.label: D

option_analysis.label: A

option_analysis.label: C

option_analysis.label: D

questions.prompt: Which person meets the stated residency requirement?

options.label: B

options.label: C

explanation.summary_zh: 條件是主要住處位於 Bramble Ward，租屋自住也符合這項居住要求。

option_analysis.label: C

explanation.summary_zh: 只有地址核驗是必須出席的場次，因此缺席被移出抽籤的句子應放在 [4]。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 待插入句的 this session 須承接會影響抽籤資格的必要場次。[4] 前面明說 all applicants must attend 地址核驗，後面再要求攜帶地址證明，正好形成必要出席、缺席後果與準備文件的完整說明。其餘三處都接在明確自願的活動之後，不能套用這項缺席後果。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: [3] 的歡迎活動是在抽籤後，且明說不論參不參加都保留已分配的菜圃；移出抽籤的後果不適用。

This drop-in session is also optional; applicants may complete the form independently. [[2]]
After the April 20 draw, successful applicants may attend a welcome session on April 26. Their plots remain assigned whether or not they attend. [[3]]

questions.prompt: Which plan would allow Ms. Soren to complete the required steps after returning from her trip?

options.label: A

options.label: B

explanation.summary_zh: 她五日返程後，可七日填表、十二日帶租約正本核驗，完成必要步驟。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 她 April 5 返回，因此 April 7 送出表格與 April 12 親自核驗都在返程之後。七日早於 April 8 截止日，十二日攜帶目前租約的正本也符合核驗要求。其他方案分別把自願活動當成必要核驗的替代、錯過表格期限，或以副本寄送取代親自出席。

evidence.quote: You mentioned that you will be away April 2–4, returning April 5, and asked which events applicants must attend.

Volunteers will offer help with the online form at the library on April 6. This drop-in session is also optional; applicants may complete the form independently.
After the April 20 draw, successful applicants may attend a welcome session on April 26. Their plots remain assigned whether or not they attend.

One visit is required: all applicants must attend the address-verification session at the community hall on April 12, between 9 A.M. and noon. [[4]] Please bring an original current utility bill or rental agreement showing your name and main home address.
