content.title: A Rental Shop Makes Room for Practice
content.scenario_summary: An equipment-rental owner initially plans screens to speed up service, then responds to customers who want to try tools by funding a staffed practice bench. The shop retains a separate collection counter for customers already sure of their choice.

documents.title: A Rental Shop Makes Room for Practice

blocks.text: A Rental Shop Makes Room for Practice
Neighbourhood Business | March 12, 2028

Rookline Tool Rental’s move to a larger shop has given owner Lillian Cole a chance to rethink how customers choose equipment. [[1]] The business rents drills, floor sanders and other tools to local residents and small contractors.
Cole initially believed that visitors mainly wanted shorter waits at the counter. [[2]] Her original proposal featured self-service tablets and video demonstrations on wall-mounted screens.

Before ordering the equipment, she asked regular customers which addition would help them most. Many said they wanted to hold a tool and try it briefly before committing to a rental. [[3]] At the new bench, customers can compare the grips of several drills and practice driving screws into scrap wood under staff supervision.
“I used to think the quickest transaction was always the best service. [[4]] I now set aside time for people who want to try a tool before taking it home,” Cole said.

Customers who are already confident about their choice can still go straight to the existing collection counter. Cole has kept that route separate from the practice area so a demonstration does not hold up customers who are ready to leave.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: To compare the performance of several new power tools

options.label: B
options.text: To advertise training courses for professional builders

options.label: C
options.text: To explain the costs involved in moving a rental business

options.label: D
options.text: To describe how a rental shop responded to customer preferences

explanation.summary_zh: 文章介紹工具租賃店如何依顧客偏好調整設備選擇與取件服務。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 搬遷提供重新規劃服務的機會，Cole 起初以為顧客主要想減少等待，詢問後卻發現不少人希望先試用。後文介紹練習桌與保留的取件櫃檯，因此重點是回應顧客偏好。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中雖提到比較電鑽握把，但沒有評測幾款新工具的性能；工具是說明試用服務的例子。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 店內有員工陪同試用，不等於宣傳給專業建築人員的正式培訓課程；顧客也包括一般居民。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 搬店是背景，文章沒有列出搬遷費用或成本明細。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。文章由店主原先的假設、顧客回饋到新的服務形式，完整說明店家如何回應需求。

evidence.quote: a chance to rethink how customers choose equipment.
Many said they wanted to hold a tool and try it briefly before committing to a rental.
Customers who are already confident about their choice can still go straight to the existing collection counter.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題要辨識背景事件與真正主線；搬遷是契機，顧客意見帶來的服務改變才是報導重點。

questions.prompt: Which activity is described at the new bench?

options.label: A
options.text: Trying drills on scrap wood while an employee supervises

options.label: B
options.text: Learning to repair the company’s older power tools

options.label: C
options.text: Recording tool-review videos for the company’s website

options.label: D
options.text: Completing a skills test required for every rental

explanation.summary_zh: 顧客可在員工陪同下，用木料邊角料練習操作電鑽鎖螺絲。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 文章描述顧客在新桌台比較電鑽握把，並在 staff supervision 下練習把螺絲鎖入 scrap wood。A 把這個活動改寫為有員工監督的電鑽試用，符合文中內容。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。電鑽、木料邊角料及員工在場監督，都對應文章對練習桌的描述。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 顧客是練習使用工具，文中沒有說要教他們維修店內較舊的工具。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 原提案提到的是在螢幕上播放示範影片，並非由顧客錄製工具評論供網站使用。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章描述的是供顧客試用的服務，沒有把技能測驗列為每一筆租賃的必要條件。

evidence.quote: At the new bench, customers can compare the grips of several drills and practice driving screws into scrap wood under staff supervision.
Her original proposal featured self-service tablets and video demonstrations on wall-mounted screens.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 活動細節題應核對動作、物件及參與方式；試用工具不等於維修、錄影或必須通過測驗。

questions.prompt: Where would this sentence fit most naturally in the passage? "She therefore redirected the money set aside for those screens to a staffed practice bench."
questions.target_text: She therefore redirected the money set aside for those screens to a staffed practice bench.

explanation.summary_zh: 插入句應放在顧客提出試用需求之後，銜接螢幕預算轉作練習桌的決定。
explanation.reasoning_zh: those screens 回指前段原案中的壁掛螢幕；therefore 把顧客希望先試用的回饋接到預算改投練習桌的決定。後句 At the new bench 則承接插入句引入的新設施，因此 [3] 同時滿足前因與後續指涉。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: [1] 前面只有搬店與重新思考服務的背景，螢幕尚未出現，those screens 沒有已建立的指涉；顧客希望試用的原因也尚未交代。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: [2] 前面只有 Cole 對縮短等待的原先看法。螢幕原案與顧客試用需求都還在後面，無法在此用 those screens 及 therefore 回接已知資訊。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。[3] 前已有螢幕原案及顧客想實際試用的回饋，插入句說明預算如何轉向，後面的 new bench 也立刻有了明確來源。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: [4] 位於 Cole 以 I 自述的直接引言中。插入句是記者以 she 敘述 Cole 的決定，放進去會把記者的第三人稱敘述混入她的第一人稱發言，無法維持該段引言的說話視角。

evidence.quote: Her original proposal featured self-service tablets and video demonstrations on wall-mounted screens.

Many said they wanted to hold a tool and try it briefly before committing to a rental. [[3]] At the new bench, customers can compare the grips of several drills and practice driving screws into scrap wood under staff supervision.
“I used to think the quickest transaction was always the best service. [[4]] I now set aside time for people who want to try a tool before taking it home,” Cole said.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 插句題要同時檢查指示詞、因果關係與後句的新名詞，並確認句子仍屬於同一位說話者或敘述者。

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the shop’s revised service?

options.label: A
options.text: It is designed chiefly to attract professional builders.

options.label: B
options.text: It accommodates renters who want different amounts of assistance.

options.label: C
options.text: It requires customers to book a lesson before collecting tools.

options.label: D
options.text: It replaces counter collection with staff demonstrations.

explanation.summary_zh: 新安排同時照顧想有人協助試用與已確定選擇、想直接取件的顧客。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 練習桌提供員工陪同操作，另一方面，已確定選擇的顧客仍能直接到原取件櫃檯。把這兩種安排合起來，可推知店家讓不同協助需求的租客各自採用適合的方式。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章說店家服務一般居民與小型承包商，沒有表示新服務主要以專業建築人員為對象。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。有人可先在員工陪同下試用，已確定者則可直接取件，顯示服務容納不同程度的協助需求。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 已確定選擇的人仍能直接到取件櫃檯，文中沒有要求每位顧客先預約課程。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 原有取件櫃檯明確保留，且與練習區分開，並沒有被員工示範完全取代。

evidence.quote: practice driving screws into scrap wood under staff supervision.

Customers who are already confident about their choice can still go straight to the existing collection counter. Cole has kept that route separate from the practice area so a demonstration does not hold up customers who are ready to leave.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 服務安排的推論題可比較兩種顧客各自有哪些選擇，再歸納業者如何兼顧不同需求。

content.title: Staffing the Trainee Interviews
content.scenario_summary: A recruitment team reallocates a writing-exercise room and administrative duties for a trainee assessment morning. Cora defers spreadsheet updates to cover check-in while Ben takes interview notes. Two rooms are available, but only one approved assessor will be present before noon.

blocks.text: Recruitment Team Chat
July 6, 2027 | Planning tomorrow’s trainee assessments
Tomorrow’s trainee interviews each need a dedicated approved assessor in the room throughout. For this round, only Dev and Elena are approved. Let’s settle rooms and support.
blocks.speaker: Asha

blocks.text: Pine is now needed for staff training tomorrow. Oak can take the written exercise instead; I’ll change that booking. Birch and Elm are both free for interviews. Shall I reserve both?
blocks.speaker: Ben

blocks.text: I’m available all morning, but Elena will be at the client site until noon. Ben, can you stay with me to take interview notes?
blocks.speaker: Dev

blocks.text: Yes, but I was down to handle candidate check-in at Reception from 9:00. We’ll need someone else there.
blocks.speaker: Ben

blocks.text: Ben and I were going to update the candidate-tracking spreadsheets tomorrow morning. Is that still our priority, or should I help with arrivals?
blocks.speaker: Cora

blocks.text: The spreadsheets can wait. Cora, please cover candidate check-in while Ben takes notes with Dev. I’ll handle candidate enquiries and collect the exercise papers afterward.
blocks.speaker: Asha

blocks.text: Works for me. I’ll prepare the sign-in sheets today and set them out tomorrow morning.
blocks.speaker: Cora

blocks.text: I’ll put Oak in the candidate reminder emails and leave the printed writing tasks there by 8:45.
blocks.speaker: Ben

blocks.text: Thanks. I’ll send the final room list once the bookings are updated.
blocks.speaker: Asha

questions.prompt: What are the participants mainly discussing?

options.label: A
options.text: Comparing applicants for a trainee position

options.label: B
options.text: Planning a staff course on recruitment spreadsheets

options.label: C
options.text: Negotiating a different time for a client appointment

options.label: D
options.text: Allocating people and rooms for candidate assessments

explanation.summary_zh: 對話主要在安排招募評選所需的場地與工作人員。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Asha 一開始提出要確認 rooms and support，之後各人討論寫作測驗改用哪個房間、誰做面談紀錄、誰接待報到，以及哪些行政工作可暫緩。D 能涵蓋整段討論。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 雖然活動是招募評選，但對話沒有比較個別應徵者的表現或資格，而是在準備活動安排。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Pine 的員工訓練與招募試算表分別被提及，但沒有人規劃教授試算表的員工課程。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Elena 拜訪客戶的行程是可用人力的限制，對話並沒有協商更改該約定。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。房間用途、面談支援、候選人報到及行政工作的重新分配，都是人員與場地配置。

evidence.quote: Let’s settle rooms and support.
Oak can take the written exercise instead; I’ll change that booking.
Cora, please cover candidate check-in while Ben takes notes with Dev.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 聊天主旨題要歸納多項決定的共同目的，避免把其中一個限制或行政細節當成整段主題。

questions.prompt: Which room does Ben plan to use for the written exercise?

explanation.summary_zh: Ben 計畫把寫作測驗從 Pine 改到 Oak。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Pine 被其他員工訓練占用後，Ben 說 Oak can take the written exercise instead，之後又確認會在提醒信中寫入 Oak，並把紙本題目放在那裡，因此選 B。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Pine 是原先考慮的場地，但現在要供員工訓練使用，所以 Ben 要改訂房間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Ben 明確指定 Oak 作為替代場地，並打算在該處放置寫作題目。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Birch 是可供面談的房間之一，並不是 Ben 指定的寫作測驗場地。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Elm 也是被提出可供面談使用的房間，不能把可用的面談房間與寫作測驗場地混淆。

evidence.quote: Pine is now needed for staff training tomorrow. Oak can take the written exercise instead; I’ll change that booking. Birch and Elm are both free for interviews.
I’ll put Oak in the candidate reminder emails and leave the printed writing tasks there by 8:45.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 場地細節題要追蹤改訂後的用途，並區分原場地、替代場地與其他活動可用的房間。

questions.prompt: What does Asha mean when she writes, "The spreadsheets can wait."?

options.label: A
options.text: Cora should postpone record updates to handle candidate arrivals.

options.label: B
options.text: Ben should use a different file for his interview notes.

options.label: C
options.text: Candidates should complete the spreadsheets after their interviews.

options.label: D
options.text: Elena should review the records before visiting the client.

explanation.summary_zh: Asha 是要暫緩資料更新，讓 Cora 先負責應徵者報到。
explanation.reasoning_zh: Cora 詢問更新招募試算表是否仍是優先工作，並表示可以協助接待。Asha 回答這些表可以等，緊接著把報到工作交給 Cora，因此這句是在調整優先順序，而不是更換檔案或取消資料工作。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。暫緩更新試算表能騰出 Cora，接替原本由 Ben 負責的候選人報到工作。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Ben 要協助面談紀錄，但 Asha 沒有討論紀錄要用哪個檔案；這句是在回應 Cora 的工作優先順序。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 試算表是 Cora 與 Ben 原定的行政工作，並非分配給應徵者的測驗；應徵者的寫作任務另有紙本題目。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Elena 的客戶拜訪只用來說明她上午不在場，Asha 並未用這句要求她在拜訪前審查紀錄。

evidence.quote: Is that still our priority, or should I help with arrivals?
The spreadsheets can wait. Cora, please cover candidate check-in while Ben takes notes with Dev.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 意圖題要看回應前的問題及緊接的工作指派；can wait 在此是在降低某項工作的當下優先順序。

questions.prompt: If both available interview rooms are reserved, what would still be true of the morning plan?

options.label: A
options.text: An interview could run in each room at the same time.

options.label: B
options.text: Cora could replace Elena as the second approved assessor.

options.label: C
options.text: Only one interview could proceed at a time before noon.

options.label: D
options.text: The written exercise would have to move back to Pine.

explanation.summary_zh: 上午只有 Dev 能擔任核准評估員，所以增加房間仍不能同時進行兩場面談。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 每場面談全程都要有一位專責的核准評估員在房內，而本輪只有 Dev 與 Elena 獲得核准。Elena 中午前在客戶現場，上午只剩 Dev 可用，因此限制在評估員人力，不會因為預訂兩間房就能並行面談。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 兩間房雖都可用，但每場都必須全程有核准評估員；上午只有 Dev，無法同時在兩間房評估。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Asha 明確說只有 Dev 與 Elena 是本輪核准評估員，並未把 Cora 列入；能接待報到不代表能接替評估資格。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。核准名單與 Elena 中午前不在場這兩項條件合起來，限制上午同一時間只能進行一場面談。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 被提出供面談使用的是 Birch 與 Elm，並不占用已改作寫作測驗的 Oak；Pine 又另有員工訓練，沒有必須改回去的依據。

evidence.quote: Tomorrow’s trainee interviews each need a dedicated approved assessor in the room throughout. For this round, only Dev and Elena are approved.
I’m available all morning, but Elena will be at the client site until noon.
Birch and Elm are both free for interviews.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 資源配置的推論要找出同時限制：有房間不等於可並行作業，還要核對全程必須在場的人員是否足夠。

content.title: A Print Studio at the Westbridge Enterprise Fair
content.scenario_summary: Lark Print Studio has booked an audience demonstration at an enterprise fair. A venue change requires the studio to match its presentation format to the new room rules and use its van height and existing setup appointment to reserve the correct unloading slot.

blocks.text: Westbridge Enterprise Fair — Exhibitor Confirmation
Issued: May 5, 2027 | Booking: EF-284
Exhibitor: Lark Print Studio | Contact: Nina Ko

Your stand is confirmed for the Westbridge Enterprise Fair on May 21 at Mason Hall. The public program runs from 11:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. Keep this confirmation for staff admission; badge collection opens at 8:00 A.M.
Reservation details
rows: A designer will demonstrate poster lettering to a seated audience.
Observation only; visitors will not use the lettering tools.
Catalogs and sample posters for viewing; no sales at the stand.
Two display tables and twelve audience chairs.
Studio van, 2.4 meters high; unloading by studio staff.

blocks.text: Space for two staff members is included in the booking. Please send any correction to the activity description by May 12, since it determines where your stand is placed. Additional staff passes can be purchased at the information desk.
Westbridge Enterprise Fair: Change of Venue
May 14, 2027 | To all confirmed exhibitors

Because repairs at Mason Hall will continue beyond May 21, the fair will take place at Calder Centre, 18 River Lane. Exhibitors retain their booked setup appointments, and the public opening hours are unchanged. Please refer to your confirmation when using the arrangements below.
Room assignments depend on what visitors do at a stand, rather than the exhibitor's industry.

The underground loading area has a vehicle-height limit of 2.1 meters. Taller vehicles must unload at the curbside area; do not enter the ramp. Curbside unloading requires a reserved slot: 8:15 A.M. for exhibitors whose booked setup starts before 10:00 A.M., or 9:15 A.M. for those whose setup starts at 10:00 A.M. or later. Select the appropriate slot through the exhibitor portal by May 18. Drivers using the underground area need no unloading reservation.
All rooms will have the furniture listed on confirmations. Staff will transfer badge records automatically; no revised admission document will be issued.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the notice?

options.label: A
options.text: To ask exhibitors to choose a later date for the fair

options.label: B
options.text: To explain arrangements for holding the fair at another site

options.label: C
options.text: To invite exhibitors to reserve larger display spaces

options.label: D
options.text: To announce shorter public opening hours for the fair

explanation.summary_zh: 通知說明展覽改至另一場地後的場地分配與卸貨安排。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 開頭先交代原場地整修未完成，因此改至 Calder Centre，後文再說明展間分配、卸貨及證件處理。這些資訊共同服務於搬遷場地後的參展安排，因此選 B。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知更換的是場地；May 21 仍是展覽日期，沒有要求參展商另選較晚的日期。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。通知先公布新場地，再交代如何依新場地規定安排展間與卸貨，符合全文目的。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 通知有展間分類與家具安排，但沒有邀請參展商預訂更大的展示空間。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中明確表示 public opening hours are unchanged，即對外開放時間維持原樣，並非縮短。

evidence.quote: Because repairs at Mason Hall will continue beyond May 21, the fair will take place at Calder Centre, 18 River Lane.
Room assignments depend on what visitors do at a stand, rather than the exhibitor's industry.
Curbside unloading requires a reserved slot:

explanation.takeaway_zh: 主旨題要把開頭宣布的變動與後續處理事項連起來，找出能涵蓋全文的選項。

questions.prompt: Why are corrections to the activity description requested by May 12?

options.label: A
options.text: To determine the number of staff passes to print

options.label: B
options.text: To prepare catalogs for visitors to take home

options.label: C
options.text: To help the organizer decide where to place the stand

options.label: D
options.text: To reserve a time for the studio van to unload

explanation.summary_zh: 確認書要求更正活動內容，因為這項內容會決定攤位配置位置。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認書中的 since 引出要求更正的原因：活動描述 determines where your stand is placed。C 的 decide where to place the stand 是同義改寫；員工證件及卸貨則是其他安排。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 確認書另外提到兩位員工名額及額外通行證，但沒有說活動描述用來決定印製多少張通行證。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 表格中的型錄與海報僅供觀看，沒有提到主辦單位需要在截止日前製作供訪客帶走的型錄。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。文中直接說活動描述會決定攤位放在哪裡，因此必須先取得正確資訊。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: May 12 是更正活動描述的期限。新通知另以 May 18 作為選擇路邊卸貨時段的期限，兩者用途不同。

evidence.quote: Please send any correction to the activity description by May 12, since it determines where your stand is placed.
Catalogs and sample posters for viewing; no sales at the stand.
Select the appropriate slot through the exhibitor portal by May 18.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 原因題可留意 since、because 等線索，並把不同截止日期各自對應的工作分清楚。

questions.prompt: The word "retain" in the notice is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: retain 在此表示保留原先預約的進場布置時段，意思接近 keep。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 受詞是 their booked setup appointments，指已訂好的布置預約。句子說場地雖變更，既有預約仍然保留；後面又說對外開放時間不變，因此 keep 符合這裡維持原安排的語意。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。keep their booked setup appointments 表示保留已訂好的布置預約，符合原句。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: request 是提出申請；這些預約已經 booked，原句說明的是如何處理既有預約，並非要求重新申請。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: verify 是核實或查證。原句表達預約繼續有效，沒有要求參展商檢查預約是否正確。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: exchange 是交換或更換；此處保留原布置預約，並非換成其他預約。

evidence.quote: Exhibitors retain their booked setup appointments, and the public opening hours are unchanged.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 字義題應把選項放回原句，確認它與受詞及上下文所表達的安排一致。

questions.prompt: In which room should Lark Print Studio's stand be located at Calder Centre?

explanation.summary_zh: 工作室讓觀眾觀看設計師示範，因此符合 Forum Room 的分配條件。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認書說設計師會向坐著的觀眾示範海報字樣，訪客僅觀看、不操作工具，也不在攤位購物。通知則依訪客在攤位的活動分配展間；觀看示範對應 Forum Room，而不是依印刷業別來選房間。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Workshop Room 適用於訪客親自嘗試活動的攤位；確認書明確說訪客不會使用字樣製作工具，不能因為現場有工具就選此房間。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。確認書的 seated audience 與示範安排，符合通知中 Forum Room 的 audience watches a demonstration。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Market Room 是訪客購物的區域。工作室雖帶型錄與海報樣本，確認書卻指定它們僅供觀看，現場不販售。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Advice Room 適用於一對一諮詢；工作室安排的是對坐席觀眾進行示範，並非個別諮詢。

evidence.quote: A designer will demonstrate poster lettering to a seated audience.
Observation only; visitors will not use the lettering tools.
Catalogs and sample posters for viewing; no sales at the stand.
Room assignments depend on what visitors do at a stand, rather than the exhibitor's industry.
Forum Room | An audience watches a demonstration.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件分類題要先找出個案的實際活動，再套用另一文件的分類條件，避免只憑行業或工具名稱判斷。

questions.prompt: Which unloading arrangement should Lark Print Studio reserve for its van?

explanation.summary_zh: 車高超過地下卸貨區限制，且布置自十點開始，所以應預約九點十五分的路邊卸貨。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認書列出廂型車高 2.4 公尺、布置預約為 10:00–10:30。通知限制地下區車高為 2.1 公尺，超高車輛須用路邊區；布置開始時間在十點或之後者，路邊時段為 9:15。十點整包含在後一條件中，因此選 D。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 兩項都不符。2.4 公尺的車輛不能進入限高 2.1 公尺的地下區；8:15 路邊時段則是給布置開始時間早於十點的參展商。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 路邊區正確，但 8:15 時段只適用於布置在十點之前開始者。工作室的布置從十點整開始，不屬於 before 10:00。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 9:15 是工作室適用的路邊卸貨時段，但地下區的 2.1 公尺限高排除了這輛 2.4 公尺的廂型車；通知也說地下區無須預約卸貨。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。車高決定使用路邊區，十點整開始布置則符合 at 10:00 A.M. or later，應預約 9:15。

evidence.quote: Setup appointment | 10:00–10:30 A.M.
Studio van, 2.4 meters high; unloading by studio staff.
Exhibitors retain their booked setup appointments
The underground loading area has a vehicle-height limit of 2.1 meters. Taller vehicles must unload at the curbside area; do not enter the ramp.
Curbside unloading requires a reserved slot: 8:15 A.M. for exhibitors whose booked setup starts before 10:00 A.M., or 9:15 A.M. for those whose setup starts at 10:00 A.M. or later.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨文件規則題要分別核對地點與時間條件，尤其注意 before 與 at...or later 是否包含界線時間。

content.title: A Harbor Operator’s New Home
content.scenario_summary: A harbor-tour operator has moved its ticket desk and departure pier without changing its itineraries. An earlier visitor describes a continuous cruise under Stone Bridge and plans to return with her father for an independent visit to an artist’s house, which requires choosing a different itinerary.

documents.title: Calder Harbor Tours: Our New Home

blocks.text: Calder Harbor Tours: Our New Home
calderharbortours.example/visit | Updated June 20, 2027

Our ticket desk and departure point have moved from Ferry Square to Custom House Landing. Follow the blue boat signs from the Custom House courtyard. Online ticket holders may go directly to the pier. Buses still stop at Ferry Square, so please allow time for the waterfront walk.
Our move has not changed the itineraries below. Only Harbor Panorama and Tern Crossing pass under Stone Bridge. Every tour has recorded commentary in English and Mandarin.
Choose your itinerary
rows: Working drydock and old ferry terminal
Old ferry terminal and Tern Island

blocks.text: For tours with a shore visit, entry to the Artist’s House is included. The house preserves the studio of local poster artist Sylvie Wen. Tern Crossing passengers receive a printed house guide and explore independently; Captain’s Choice passengers join a staff member for a guided walk through the rooms.

documents.title: A Relaxing Morning on the Water

blocks.text: A Relaxing Morning on the Water
Review by Amira Dale | June 8, 2027 | Rating: 4 out of 5
I booked online but bought postcards at the Ferry Square desk before boarding. At the gangway, a crew member helped when my phone would not display my ticket. That saved me a lot of worry.

My son photographed Stone Bridge as we passed beneath it, and I enjoyed watching workers at the drydock. There was no shore stop on our cruise. The recorded commentary was easy to follow. We ate the sandwiches we had brought; there was no café on board.

Next time, I will bring my father, who is interested in Sylvie Wen. We would like to go inside her studio house. He spends ages examining details, so we would rather not follow a group through the rooms. A short printed overview would suit us better.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the web page?

options.label: A
options.text: To promote private cruises for company outings

options.label: B
options.text: To compare the prices of several harbor attractions

options.label: C
options.text: To explain tour arrangements following a move

options.label: D
options.text: To request feedback about recently introduced tours

explanation.summary_zh: 網頁介紹遷址後的報到位置、交通方式及仍然提供的遊程。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 標題宣布業者的新據點，首段說明售票處與出發地點已搬遷，接著交代路線維持不變並列出遊程內容。C 能涵蓋這些資訊；文中沒有價格比較或徵求意見的要求。

option_analysis.label: A

content.title: A Delayed Catering Delivery
content.scenario_summary: Juniper Table offers four fixed catering formats. An organizer requests cold, plant-based food in shared serving dishes for an Aster Hall workshop. A van breakdown pushes the expected delivery into a later session, so the organizer’s rule against interrupting speakers shifts lunch to the next session boundary.

documents.title: Juniper Table Takes Lunch Beyond the Dining Room

blocks.text: Juniper Table Takes Lunch Beyond the Dining Room
Riverton Business Review | September 7, 2027

Until recently, Juniper Table catered mainly for evening celebrations. Now the neighborhood restaurant is also serving local workplaces, with four lunch packages designed for different settings. Weekly menus change, but the package formats remain fixed.
The restaurant’s workplace lunch range
rows: Meat and vegetable dishes, served cold

blocks.text: “A training room and a staff picnic need different arrangements,” says owner Leah Yeo. “We want customers to choose a format that fits the way they will eat.” For shared meals, the restaurant supplies reusable serving dishes and collects them the following day. Individual boxes are made from recycled cardboard.
From: Elena Morales | To: Workshop Team
Date: September 11, 2027, 3:30 P.M. | Subject: Lunch for the donor workshop

Juniper Table has confirmed 24 lunches for our September 12 workshop in Studio B at Aster Hall. I left the menu selection to them, with these instructions: everything must be plant-based and intended to be eaten cold, and guests should help themselves from shared serving dishes. Set the serving table inside Studio B rather than in the lobby. Please tell me by 5:00 P.M. today if the head count changes.
The timetable below excludes lunch. We will stop at the first session boundary after the food arrives, without interrupting a speaker. After lunch, shift the remaining sessions accordingly.
Session timetable before inserting lunch
Juniper Table: Catering Delivery Update
September 12, 2027 | Posted at 10:20 A.M.

A breakdown in our delivery van has delayed today’s catering route. A replacement vehicle has been cleared for use after a safety check, and lunches for Aster Hall are now expected at 12:40 P.M., replacing the earlier 12:15 P.M. estimate.

Food preparation is on schedule. Cold orders will remain in refrigerated storage until loading. We apologize for the disruption. Customers can contact catering@junipertable.example for delivery updates.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the article?

explanation.summary_zh: 文章介紹 Juniper Table 如何以不同供餐形式拓展職場外燴服務。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 首段說餐廳從晚間聚會外燴拓展至當地工作場所，表格接著比較四種午餐方案，老闆的引言則解釋不同用餐情境需要不同安排。C 能涵蓋這些重點。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章介紹餐廳提供的外燴方案，沒有教辦公室如何經營或管理共用廚房。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文中提到業務服務對象擴大，並未宣布餐廳搬遷至新地點。

option_analysis.label: C

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 文章雖涉及供餐及餐具回收，卻沒有職缺資訊或招募配送人員的要求。

evidence.quote: Now the neighborhood restaurant is also serving local workplaces, with four lunch packages designed for different settings.
“We want customers to choose a format that fits the way they will eat.”

explanation.takeaway_zh: 文章主旨可由開頭介紹的新方向，再配合表格與人物引言的共同重點判斷。

questions.prompt: According to the email, which statement is NOT true?

explanation.summary_zh: 電子郵件指定 Studio B，而不是大廳，作為這場活動的供餐地點。

option_analysis.label: A

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件明確要求人數若有變動，當天下午五點前告知 Elena，因此這項敘述正確。

option_analysis.label: D

explanation.takeaway_zh: 否定細節題可逐一對照人數、日期、期限與地點，避免被同一建築內的不同位置混淆。

questions.prompt: The word "cleared" in the notice is closest in meaning to

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。approved for use 表示獲准使用，符合通過安全檢查後可投入配送的意思。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: emptied 是清空內容物。此處的安全檢查與 for use 指向使用許可，並沒有說車內物品已被搬空。

evidence.quote: A replacement vehicle has been cleared for use after a safety check

explanation.takeaway_zh: 判斷多義字時，要看其後的固定搭配與附近事件；for use 加上安全檢查可指出核准的語意。

questions.prompt: Which catering package is most consistent with Elena Morales’s instructions?

explanation.summary_zh: Field 同時符合全植物性、冷食及共用餐盤自取的三項要求。

option_analysis.label: B

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Courtyard 雖是植物性冷食，卻裝在個別餐盒中，不符合來賓從共用盛盤取餐的安排。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Field 是植物性冷食，並以 shared platters 提供，同時符合食材、食用溫度及供餐形式。

Weekly menus change, but the package formats remain fixed.

questions.prompt: Under the revised delivery estimate, which session should be followed by lunch?

explanation.summary_zh: 新預計送達時間落在 Volunteer Case Studies 進行中，因此要等該場結束後用餐。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 通知把 Aster Hall 的預計送達時間從 12:15 改為 12:40。郵件要求餐點送達後，在第一個場次交界處用餐，不打斷講者。12:40 位於 12:35 至 1:10 的 Volunteer Case Studies 之間，所以依這份更新後的估計，應在該場結束後用餐。

our September 12 workshop in Studio B at Aster Hall.

content.title: Community Design Advice from an Architectural Studio
content.scenario_summary: A registered nonprofit has four possible projects for an architectural studio’s complimentary concept-review program. blocks.text: Marden Architecture Studio: Community Sketch Program
Applications open April 2–16, 2028

Registered nonprofit groups may nominate one project for our Community Sketch program, which offers a free concept review. To qualify, the finished space must be open to the general public, and the site owner must have approved the proposed work in writing. We cannot entertain proposals once construction has begun.

Applications must include a site sketch and recent photographs. Upload these at mardenstudio.example/community by April 16. Selected groups will meet with an architect online; no site visit is included. The free preparation sessions listed separately help applicants prepare their images and drawings. They are not the review itself.
Community Sketch: Application Preparation Sessions
April 2028 | All sessions online
These sessions are open to all nonprofit groups, including those still choosing a project. Register using the session code; a joining link will be emailed to you.

option_analysis.reason_zh: 公告列出一般適用的資格條件，沒有比較數個具體候選場址。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 提供的是免費概念審查及與建築師的線上會談，並非以折扣價承包施工服務。

evidence.quote: Registered nonprofit groups may nominate one project for our Community Sketch program, which offers a free concept review.
Applications must include a site sketch and recent photographs. Upload these at mardenstudio.example/community by April 16.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 申請公告的主旨通常要同時涵蓋服務內容、申請對象及辦理方式，不只抓單一資格條件。

questions.prompt: Where will the preparation sessions take place?

explanation.summary_zh: 時程表明確指出所有準備課程都在線上進行。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 時程表上方寫著 All sessions online，下文又說完成報名後會寄出 joining link，表示參加者透過網路加入課程，並不需要到建築工作室或提案場址上課。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 課程由建築工作室的計畫提供，但時程表沒有要求參加者到工作室，反而明說全部在線上。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 課程內容可能涉及場址照片或草圖，但進行方式是線上，並非帶領參加者到各提案場址。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 時程表沒有把公共圖書館列為上課地點；明確提供的形式是 online。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。online 及報名後寄送加入連結，皆支持透過網路參加。

evidence.quote: All sessions online
Register using the session code; a joining link will be emailed to you.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 地點細節題要分清主辦單位與實際參加方式；online 和 joining link 都是線上活動的線索。

questions.prompt: The word "entertain" in the notice is closest in meaning to

explanation.summary_zh: entertain proposals 在此是考慮、受理提案的意思。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 這一段在界定哪些提案符合資格，原句說一旦施工已開始，工作室就不會 entertain proposals。這裡的 entertain 搭配提案，意思是將其納入考慮，對應 consider。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: finance 是提供資金。原句在說是否考慮提案，並非承諾替工程提供經費；免費概念審查也不等於工程補助。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: present 是提出或展示。此處工作室是評估申請的一方，entertain 表達考慮收到的提案，不是由工作室提出提案。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。consider proposals 表示考慮提案，符合這裡以施工狀態決定是否受理的語境。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: postpone 是延後。原句依施工已開始這項條件排除提案，並非單純把審查日期往後挪。

evidence.quote: We cannot entertain proposals once construction has begun.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 商務語境中的多義字可依受詞判斷；entertain 與 proposals 搭配時可表示納入考慮。

questions.prompt: Which of Ella’s proposals meets the project eligibility conditions in the notice?

explanation.summary_zh: Union Kitchen 同時符合向公眾開放、取得工程書面同意及尚未開工的條件。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 公告要求完工後向一般大眾開放、場地所有人已書面同意擬進行的工程，且尚未開始施工。郵件說 Trust 是已登記的非營利團體；其四個提案中，只有 Union Kitchen 同時滿足全部專案條件。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Union Kitchen 將向所有人開放，已取得場地所有人對工程的書面同意，而且尚未開工，三項條件都符合。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Canal Reading Room 雖會對所有人開放且尚未施工，場地所有人卻只有口頭同意，缺少公告要求的書面核准。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Hill Street Pocket Park 已有書面同意且尚未施工，但僅供 Trust 會員進入，不符合向一般大眾開放的要求。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: Station Garden 有公眾使用及書面同意的條件，但上週已開始施工，公告明確排除已開工的提案。

evidence.quote: To qualify, the finished space must be open to the general public, and the site owner must have approved the proposed work in writing. We cannot entertain proposals once construction has begun.
We are a registered nonprofit
Union Kitchen: It would be open to everyone. We have the owner’s written approval for the work, and construction has not begun.
The owner has agreed verbally but has not provided written approval.
Access would be limited to Trust members.
Construction began last week.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 資格配對題要逐項核對必要條件，特別區分口頭與書面同意、會員使用與公眾使用，以及規劃與已開工。

questions.prompt: Which session code should Ella select for the preparation help she requests?

explanation.summary_zh: Ella 需要拍攝申請用照片的協助，且只能參加四月九日，因此應選 S2。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 郵件說 Ella 想學如何拍出對申請有用的場址照片，並表示四月九日可參加、十日不能參加。時程表的 S2 與 S3 都教申請用照片拍攝，但只有 S2 在四月九日，因此同時符合主題與時間。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: S1 雖在 Ella 可參加的四月九日，主題卻是在場址草圖上標示出入路線，不是她要求的照片拍攝。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。S2 教如何拍攝清楚的申請用場址照片，日期是四月九日，與她的需求及可參加日期均吻合。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: S3 的拍照主題符合需求，但安排在四月十日；Ella 明確說那一天無法參加任何課程。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: S4 教按比例準備粗略草圖，並非拍照，而且也在 Ella 無法參加的四月十日。

evidence.quote: I would also like help photographing a site so the images will be useful for the application. I can attend on April 9, but I cannot join any sessions on April 10.
S1 | April 9, 10:00–11:00 A.M. | Showing access routes on a site sketch
S2 | April 9, 2:00–3:00 P.M. | Taking clear site photographs for an application
S3 | April 10, 10:00–11:00 A.M. | Taking clear site photographs for an application
S4 | April 10, 2:00–3:00 P.M. | Preparing a rough sketch to scale

explanation.takeaway_zh: 課程選擇題需要同時核對學習主題與可參加時間；只符合其中一項，仍不是最適合的場次。

content.title: Revising a Building-Care Appointment
content.scenario_summary: A building manager corrects a maintenance booking made from an outdated floor plan. Reception now requires carpet extraction, while corridor polishing, routine vacuuming, table moving, and the access window remain unchanged. The contractor must choose a crew with both specialist services during the booked window.

blocks.text: Aster Property Care — Booking Confirmation
Issued: October 29, 2027 | Booking: BC-682
Customer: Bramwell House | Contact: Anika Shah, Facilities Manager
Visit: November 8, 2027 | Building access: 10:00 A.M.–1:00 P.M.
Thank you for booking our building-care service. The work covered by this appointment is listed below. Please check the areas and methods carefully before we assign a crew.
Confirmed work
rows: Move two spare tables into the storeroom

blocks.text: Please clear loose personal items from the meeting-room floor before arrival and leave the storeroom key with security. Our crew will collect it there. Equipment and supplies are included. We will confirm the crew assignment after checking the final work list.
From: Anika Shah | To: Operations Coordinator, Aster Property Care
Date: November 3, 2027 | Subject: Correction to booking BC-682

For our November 8 appointment, please revise the reception work. That floor was carpeted during last month’s refurbishment; the plan I used to make our booking was older. Please use carpet extraction there instead of hard-floor polishing. Keep all other listed work and the confirmed access window unchanged.

Please do not lift or replace any reception carpet tiles, even if a mark remains after cleaning. The carpet maker’s representative will inspect that floor on November 9 before we decide whether replacement is necessary. Send me the revised crew assignment once it is settled.
Aster Property Care — Crew Availability
Planning roster issued November 5, 2027 | Availability for November 8
All crews provide routine vacuuming and furniture moving. For specialist work, choose a crew with that service listed in its column. Assignments must fit the available window.
Unassigned crews

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Shah write the email?

options.label: A
options.text: To revise instructions for a scheduled maintenance visit

options.label: B
options.text: To cancel work because the building is being refurbished

options.label: C
options.text: To request a refund for damaged floor coverings

options.label: D
options.text: To arrange an inspection by the cleaning company

explanation.summary_zh: Shah 女士寫信是要更正已預約維護工作的內容。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 郵件開頭直接要求 revise the reception work，接著把接待區的硬質地板拋光改為地毯抽洗，並補充不得拆換地毯塊的指示。她要求保留其他工作及進場時段，因此不是取消預約。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。郵件更改接待區的處理方法，並提供當次作業的進一步指示。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 整修是在上個月進行，郵件仍要求十一月八日到場，且保留其他工作，並沒有取消服務。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件提到污痕與未來是否需要更換地毯的判斷，但沒有要求退款，也沒有說維護公司造成損壞。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 十一月九日的檢查者是地毯製造商的代表，而非清潔公司；寫信的主要目的仍是修改已排定的維護工作。

evidence.quote: For our November 8 appointment, please revise the reception work.
Please use carpet extraction there instead of hard-floor polishing. Keep all other listed work and the confirmed access window unchanged.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 郵件目的題可從開頭的要求動詞判斷，再核對後文是在修改、取消或新增哪一項安排。

questions.prompt: According to the confirmation, what should building staff do before the visit?

options.label: A
options.text: Move the spare tables out of the staff lounge

options.label: B
options.text: Supply vacuum-cleaning equipment for the crew

options.label: C
options.text: Remove loose belongings from the meeting-room floor

options.label: D
options.text: Bring the storeroom key to the contractor’s office

explanation.summary_zh: 確認書要求先清除會議室地板上散放的個人物品。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認書末段以 Please clear 開頭，要求到場前把會議室地板上的個人物品移開。搬動休息室的備用桌則列在承包商工作表中；儲藏室鑰匙是留給警衛，而不是送到承包商辦公室。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 搬兩張備用桌到儲藏室是確認工作表中的服務項目，不是要求大樓人員事前自行完成的工作。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 確認書把設備與耗材列入服務，沒有要求大樓人員提供吸塵設備。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。remove loose belongings 是 clear loose personal items 的改寫，對象與地點都符合原文。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 確認書要求把鑰匙留在警衛處，由工作人員到場領取，並非送到承包商辦公室。

evidence.quote: Please clear loose personal items from the meeting-room floor before arrival and leave the storeroom key with security. Our crew will collect it there. Equipment and supplies are included.
Staff lounge | Move two spare tables into the storeroom

explanation.takeaway_zh: 作業細節題要分清委託方的事前準備與承包商的服務項目，也要核對物品交付的位置。

questions.prompt: What is implied by Ms. Shah’s instructions about the carpet tiles?

options.label: A
options.text: She expects every stain to be removed during the cleaning visit.

options.label: B
options.text: She wants the existing floor covering available for a later assessment.

options.label: C
options.text: The carpet maker has authorized replacements by the maintenance crew.

options.label: D
options.text: The inspection must occur before the cleaning appointment can proceed.

explanation.summary_zh: 她要求保留現有地毯塊，以便之後由製造商代表檢查。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 她說即使清潔後仍有污痕，也不要拆起或更換地毯塊；下一句說製造商代表將在十一月九日檢查，再決定是否有更換必要。把兩項訊息連起來，可推知她想讓現有地毯保留供後續評估。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件沒有明確表達她預期每一處污漬都會去除；反而交代仍有污痕時如何處理，因此不能據此推知這項期待。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。保留原地毯的指示與隔天安排的檢查相連，支持現有地毯需留供後續評估的推論。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 郵件明說不要拆起或更換地毯塊，而且是否需要更換要等檢查後決定，沒有授權維護人員當次更換。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 清潔預約是十一月八日，製造商檢查是十一月九日；檢查排在清潔之後，並非開始清潔前必須完成的程序。

evidence.quote: For our November 8 appointment

Please do not lift or replace any reception carpet tiles, even if a mark remains after cleaning. The carpet maker’s representative will inspect that floor on November 9 before we decide whether replacement is necessary.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 推論題可連結保留物品的指示與後續檢查安排，但不能把可能更換推成已授權更換或保證清潔結果。

questions.prompt: Which area will still need hard-floor polishing after the requested change?

explanation.summary_zh: 接待區改為地毯抽洗，原訂的東側走廊拋光則維持不變。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認書原先把接待區與東側走廊都列為硬質地板拋光。郵件只把接待區改成地毯抽洗，並要求其餘工作維持原樣，因此東側走廊仍需要原訂的拋光服務。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: 休息室原訂工作是把兩張備用桌移入儲藏室，沒有列入硬質地板拋光。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: 接待區原本要拋光，但郵件正是把這一區改為地毯抽洗，因此不再是保留拋光的區域。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。東側走廊原訂硬質地板拋光，且不在此次接待區變更範圍內，依其他工作不變的指示仍須拋光。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 會議室原訂工作是一般吸塵，郵件沒有把它改成拋光。

evidence.quote: Reception | Hard-floor polishing
East corridor | Hard-floor polishing
Please use carpet extraction there instead of hard-floor polishing. Keep all other listed work and the confirmed access window unchanged.
please revise the reception work.

explanation.takeaway_zh: 原訂單與更正通知要對照閱讀：先界定被修改的區域，再保留明確說明不變的其他項目。

questions.prompt: Which crew meets both the service and access requirements for the revised booking?

explanation.summary_zh: Maple 同時提供兩種專門清潔服務，且可在原訂十點至下午一點的時段進場。
explanation.reasoning_zh: 確認書保留東側走廊拋光及十點至下午一點的進場時段；郵件新增接待區地毯抽洗並保留其他工作。時程表說各隊均可一般吸塵與搬家具，所以要比較的是兩種專門服務與可用時段。只有 Maple 三項皆符合。

option_analysis.label: A
option_analysis.reason_zh: Alder 的可用時段正確，也能做硬質地板拋光，但未列地毯抽洗，無法符合變更後接待區的服務需求。

option_analysis.label: B
option_analysis.reason_zh: Birch 的可用時段正確，且能做地毯抽洗，但沒有硬質地板拋光，不能完成仍保留的東側走廊工作。

option_analysis.label: C
option_analysis.reason_zh: Cedar 具備兩種專門服務，但只能在下午一點至四點出勤，與原訂且維持不變的上午十點至下午一點進場時段不符。

option_analysis.label: D
option_analysis.reason_zh: 正確。Maple 可在上午十點至下午一點出勤，同時提供拋光與地毯抽洗；一般吸塵及搬桌也屬各隊共同服務。

evidence.quote: Building access: 10:00 A.M.–1:00 P.M.
East corridor | Hard-floor polishing
Please use carpet extraction there instead of hard-floor polishing. Keep all other listed work and the confirmed access window unchanged.
All crews provide routine vacuuming and furniture moving. For specialist work, choose a crew with that service listed in its column. Assignments must fit the available window.
Maple | 10:00 A.M.–1:00 P.M. | Hard-floor polishing and carpet extraction
Cedar | 1:00–4:00 P.M. | Hard-floor polishing and carpet extraction

explanation.takeaway_zh: 跨三文件派工題應整合原有工作、最新變更及人員時程；具備全部技能，仍須符合不可更動的進場時段。
